chapters.title: Chapter 235: Mage Royale [II / Bonus - ]
paragraphs: The howling gale of displaced air and pulverized dust was still swirling through the stadium when the remaining eight Mages snapped out of their shock.
They weren’t weak civilians at all.
They were trained combatants living in the ruthless Sovereign Realm under Silas Graves and his commander.
Seeing first, Calia and now Morrigan get blasted out cold in the opening five seconds didn’t make them run... it made their instincts kick into overdrive.
"She’s out of her fucking mind!" Valeria yelled, her short-cropped red hair whipping violently in the wind. "Don’t let her set her footing! Take her down first!"
FWOOSH!
Valeria didn’t hesitate.
She thrust both of her palms forward, and two massive superheated fireballs erupted from her hands, roaring through the air like twin miniature suns.
The radiation melted the falling dust in mid-air, scorching the dirt track beneath as they hurtled straight toward Kadi!
At the exact same microsecond, Lia brought her wooden focus staff around in a sweeping, two-handed arc.
SWISH! SWISH! SWISH!
Three crescent-shaped blades of razor-sharp wind tore through the air, flanking Valeria’s fireballs from the left.
The wind blades caught the tail end of the flames, fanning the fire into a roaring, combined inferno that engulfed the entire center lane of the arena.
"HA! IS THAT ALL?!" Kadi screamed, her unhinged grin stretching so wide her cheeks looked like they were going to tear.
STOMP!
She slammed her left heel down into the dirt.
RUMBLE!
A curved, ten-foot-thick wall of solid bedrock erupted out of the earth directly in front of her once again.
BOOM!
Valeria’s fiery combined blast slammed flush into the stone barrier, exploding in a towering mushroom cloud of black smoke, orange fire, and shattered rock splinters.
The heat was so intense it scorched the wooden stadium railings twenty meters away, but Kadi’s earth wall held firm.
ZIP!
Out of the rising black smoke, Morrigan, the Shadow Weaver, materialized directly behind Kadi’s back.
’I won’t do the same thing again...’
In her hands was a singular sword woven from pure condensed darkness, aimed directly at Kadi’s kidneys!
"Ah once more? You really don’t learn your lesson..."
Kadi dodged her slash and her hand began to vibrate as she was prepared to slam it into her however...
BOOM!
Kadi and Morrigan were forced to step back as some crazy had launched lightning right in the middle of them.
"Don’t give her room!" Seraina roared, her boisterous laugh echoing as she jumped straight over the smoke!

Blue crackling electricity surged across her arms and shoulders like wild serpents as she brought her fists together above her head, channeling her Lightning aura into a dense vibrating sphere of high-voltage arc power.
"Take this!"
KRA-THOOM!
Seraina drove her electrified fist straight into the top of Kadi’s defensive stone wall!
The wall shattered into a million exploding cobblestones as the lightning shockwave burst downward, scorching the dirt floor black with voltage arcs spider-webbed in every direction.
BANG!
Kadi was forced to leap backward once again, her boots scraping across the dirt track as blue sparks singed her sandy-brown hair.
Unfortunately the same thing could not be said for Morrigan as she was caught in the cross fire with the explosion knocking her out.
"Sorry, Mori darling but I need to get that position!"
"Eat this, crazy!" Eliora screamed, stepping up from the right flank.
The stern Ice Sculptor thrust her crystal orb forward and the ambient moisture in the hot morning air instantly froze into hundreds of razor-sharp ice needles hovering in mid-air.
SWOOSH!
With a flick of her wrist, the storm of ice needles shot forward like a gatling gun, aiming to impale Kadi’s arms and legs.
’They’re actually doing very well... Spending time with me can’t be that motivating, can it?’
CLANG! CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!
Kadi didn’t even bother casting an defensive spell as she threw her body forward into a wild roll, avoiding the primary arc of ice needles.
Three of the sharp ice shards grazed her shoulder and thigh, slicing through her tunic and drawing bright red blood, but she didn’t even flinch.
She sprung off the ground like an untamed beast, closing the distance on Eliora in a fraction of a second.
THWACK!
"No you eat!"
Kadi didn’t use magic as she drove her fist straight into Eliora’s jaw.
A sickening crack echoed through the stadium as Eliora’s head snapped back.
The stern looking ice mage went limp immediately with her crystal orb falling from her numb fingers and shattering on the dirt as her body collapsed sideways onto the ground, completely knocked out.
"SHE’S THROWING HANDS?!" Venma gasped in utter shock from the back lines!
"THIS IS A MAGE ROYALE, NOT A BRAWL!" Thalia yelled, her quiet demeanor vanishing as she stomped both boots into the arena floor.
Thalia, the Earth Shaper, raised her arms, attempting to override Kadi’s control over the dirt!
RUMBLE!
The ground beneath Kadi’s feet turned into liquid mud, sinking her down to her knees!
"NOW! JUMP HER!" Aurelia shouted!
The tall elegant Light Weaver didn’t waste time with long incantations.
She charged forward alongside Thalia with her hands glowing with blinding solid-light daggers!

Two Mages tried jumping Kadi simultaneously while she was trapped in the mud pit as Aurelia thrust her solid-light daggers toward Kadi’s chest, while Thalia swung a heavy stone-coated gauntlet straight at her head!
BANG!
CLANG!

Kadi’s unhinged grin only grew wider... While she was trapped in the mud, she ducked her head low, letting Thalia’s heavy stone fist graze the top of her skull, tearing skin and sending blood trickling down her forehead into her eyes!
With her eyes stinging with blood and brown earth mana, Kadi reached up with both hands, grabbing Aurelia’s wrist and Thalia’s arm simultaneously.
"GOTCHA, SWEETIES!" Kadi cackled.
THUD!
Using pure, raw physical momentum and reinforcement magic, Kadi violently slammed both girls’ heads together with a brutal, bone-crunching impact.
CRACK!
Aurelia and Thalia’s eyes rolled up into their heads instantly.
Their spells dissolved into fine dust as both women collapsed face-first into the mud beside her, completely unconscious!
Up in the viewing box, Silas leaned forward against the wooden railing, a low whistle escaping his lips.

"Damn," Silas muttered, watching the sandy-brown-haired girl wipe blood out of her eyes with her forearm. "She’s not just a caster... She’s a straight-up pit fighter. Is she perhaps related to Brida?"
Beside him, Morwenna took a slow sip from her wooden mug with a wicked approving smirk spreading across her sharp face.
"I like her, Captain. She’s got pirate grit. She doesn’t give a damn about proper form... she just wants to cave skulls in."

Eluned, still clinging tightly to Silas’s right arm, sniffed indignantly, though even her divine eyes flickered with surprise. "She’s far too chaotic... but her earth density is surprisingly pure for a mortal."
"Regardless, Morwenna. Our mages are glass cannons, weren’t you teaching them physical coordination or something?!"
Morwenna’s cheeks redenned.
’I-I forgot...’
Down in the arena, the battle reached a boiling point.
Out of the original ten contestants, six were already unconscious on the dirt.
Only four remained standing: Kadi, Valeria, Lia and Seraina
Kadi dragged herself out of the mud pit with her sandy-brown tunic shredded, her arms covered in cuts, and blood dripping steadily from her head down her cheek.
Yet her brown-glowing eyes burned with an unholy light.
Valeria, Lia, and Seraina backed up into a tight triangular formation, their breath coming in heavy gasps.
"We can’t fight her one-by-one!" Valeria spat, blood trickling from her lip where a stray rock splinter had hit her. "She counters direct physical ground attacks so I’m wiping the whole ring!"
"Valeria, wait!" Lia gasped, holding her wooden focus staff with trembling hands. "Your mana output—"
"SHUT UP AND COVER ME!" Valeria screamed!
Valeria planted her boots wide, throwing both arms straight up into the sky.
BOOM!

A massive, terrifying surge of crimson mana erupted from her body like a volcanic pillar. The air inside the stadium instantly spiked by twenty degrees as the melting snow outside the arena walls evaporated into white steam before it even touched the stone channels!

Hovering fifteen feet above the center of the arena, a colossal, terrifying fireball began to condense! It grew from five feet... to ten feet... to a massive twenty-foot sphere of churning superheated flame!
The heat was so intense that the wooden bleachers in the stadium began to singe and smoke.
Valeria was attempting to summon a massive fireball over ALL of their heads to knock out everyone in the ring at once!
"DIE, YOU CRAZY BASTARD!" Valeria shrieked, her face pale from mana exhaustion as she brought her arms crashing down.
The massive sun-like fireball plummeted straight down toward the dirt floor, threatening to incinerate the remaining contestants and blast the entire arena to ash.
"SERAINA! LIA! DO IT NOW!" Kadi yelled, her voice cutting through the roaring flames. It would take all of them out for sure...
For a split second, the remaining two mages didn’t attack Kadi... they reacted to the incoming apocalyptic fireball instead.
Lia thrust her focus staff upward!
SWOOSH!
A massive hurricane gale blasted out from her wand, creating a temporary air-cushion beneath the falling giant fireball, slowing its descent by a fraction of a second.
Seraina charged forward, leaping off the ground and channeling every last drop of her lightning mana into a spear.
KRA-THOOM!
Seraina’s lightning spear impaled the center of Valeria’s giant fireball, causing the condensed mana structure to destabilize mid-air.
BOOOOOM!
The massive fireball detonated prematurely ten feet above the ground!
An explosion of roaring red flame, shockwaves, and superheated wind exploded outward in every direction as the force of it all blasted Valeria, Lia, and Seraina off their feet simultaneously.
BANG! BANG! BANG!
All three women were hurled through the air like ragdolls by their own combined elemental backlash, crashing violently into the arena’s wooden boundary walls.
They hit the timber barriers hard and slid down into the dirt, completely unconscious with their mana reserves utterly depleted.
The smoke cleared slowly.
The center of the arena was a scorched, smoking crater of melted rock and burnt dirt.
Standing right in the center of the crater, covered in soot, third-degree burns, and drenched in her own blood, was Kadi.
She had survived the mid-air blast by pulling a dense cocoon of stone around herself at the last second.
The stone cocoon crumbled into fine dust, revealing her battered trembling form.
Kadi stood alone.
All nine of her opponents were scattered across the ring, completely knocked out cold.
The stadium went dead silent.
Kadi let out a long wheezing breath with the brown glow in her eyes slowly faded, returning to her normal sandy-brown color.
Her knees buckled under the weight of physical exhaustion and blood loss.
THUD!
Kadi lowered herself to her knees in the middle of the scorched crater.
She was bleeding quite a lot with deep gashes lined her arms, her head wound was dripping red onto her collarbones, and her mana core was completely empty.
Yet, as she knelt there in the dirt, a wide euphoric smile spread across her blood-stained face.
She raised her head toward the Lord’s viewing box with her breath coming in ragged gasps.
"I... I won..." Kadi wheezed softly, her voice raspy. "My Lord... I won..."
Up in the viewing box, Silas watched her kneel in the dirt, a proud satisfied grin breaking across his sharp face.
"Aeliana, drop the barrier," Silas commanded smoothly.
Eluned, seeing the girl’s severe injuries, didn’t wait for an order.
The Nature Goddess raised her delicate hands into the air from where she sat beside Silas.
FLASH!
A breathtaking, radiant wave of emerald-green divine light washed over the entire stadium.
The gentle, soothing nature aura enveloped all ten mages simultaneously.
Instantly, the deep gashes on Kadi’s body closed up, her bleeding stopped, her third-degree burns vanished, and her pale cheeks regained their healthy color.
Across the arena, the other nine unconscious mages let out soft sighs of relief as their injuries were completely healed by Eluned’s divine touch.
Silas didn’t use the stairs.
He stepped right over the wooden railing of the viewing box and vaulted down twenty feet, landing lightly on his boots in the center of the dirt crater beside Kadi.
THUD!
Silas walked over, looking down at the sandy-haired Mage who was still kneeling in the dirt.
He reached out and gently patted her head, a warm, genuine smile on his face.

"Congratulations, Kadi," Silas said, his deep voice carrying clearly across the arena. "You put on a hell of a show. You fought with true grit and showed me very true potential today so you earned this."

sentences.text: The howling gale of displaced air and pulverized dust was still swirling through the stadium when the remaining eight Mages snapped out of their shock.
They weren’t weak civilians at all.
They were trained combatants living in the ruthless Sovereign Realm under Silas Graves and his commander.
Seeing first, Calia and now Morrigan get blasted out cold in the opening five seconds didn’t make them run... it made their instincts kick into overdrive.
"She’s out of her fucking mind!" Valeria yelled, her short-cropped red hair whipping violently in the wind.
"Don’t let her set her footing!
Take her down first!"
FWOOSH!
Valeria didn’t hesitate.
She thrust both of her palms forward, and two massive superheated fireballs erupted from her hands, roaring through the air like twin miniature suns.
The radiation melted the falling dust in mid-air, scorching the dirt track beneath as they hurtled straight toward Kadi!
At the exact same microsecond, Lia brought her wooden focus staff around in a sweeping, two-handed arc.
SWISH!
SWISH!
SWISH!
Three crescent-shaped blades of razor-sharp wind tore through the air, flanking Valeria’s fireballs from the left.
The wind blades caught the tail end of the flames, fanning the fire into a roaring, combined inferno that engulfed the entire center lane of the arena.
"HA!
IS THAT ALL?!" Kadi screamed, her unhinged grin stretching so wide her cheeks looked like they were going to tear.
STOMP!
She slammed her left heel down into the dirt.
RUMBLE!
A curved, ten-foot-thick wall of solid bedrock erupted out of the earth directly in front of her once again.
BOOM!
Valeria’s fiery combined blast slammed flush into the stone barrier, exploding in a towering mushroom cloud of black smoke, orange fire, and shattered rock splinters.
The heat was so intense it scorched the wooden stadium railings twenty meters away, but Kadi’s earth wall held firm.
ZIP!
Out of the rising black smoke, Morrigan, the Shadow Weaver, materialized directly behind Kadi’s back.
’I won’t do the same thing again...’
In her hands was a singular sword woven from pure condensed darkness, aimed directly at Kadi’s kidneys!
"Ah once more?
You really don’t learn your lesson..."
Kadi dodged her slash and her hand began to vibrate as she was prepared to slam it into her however...
BOOM!
Kadi and Morrigan were forced to step back as some crazy had launched lightning right in the middle of them.
"Don’t give her room!" Seraina roared, her boisterous laugh echoing as she jumped straight over the smoke!

Blue crackling electricity surged across her arms and shoulders like wild serpents as she brought her fists together above her head, channeling her Lightning aura into a dense vibrating sphere of high-voltage arc power.
"Take this!"
KRA-THOOM!
Seraina drove her electrified fist straight into the top of Kadi’s defensive stone wall!
The wall shattered into a million exploding cobblestones as the lightning shockwave burst downward, scorching the dirt floor black with voltage arcs spider-webbed in every direction.
BANG!
Kadi was forced to leap backward once again, her boots scraping across the dirt track as blue sparks singed her sandy-brown hair.
Unfortunately the same thing could not be said for Morrigan as she was caught in the cross fire with the explosion knocking her out.
"Sorry, Mori darling but I need to get that position!"
"Eat this, crazy!" Eliora screamed, stepping up from the right flank.
The stern Ice Sculptor thrust her crystal orb forward and the ambient moisture in the hot morning air instantly froze into hundreds of razor-sharp ice needles hovering in mid-air.
SWOOSH!
With a flick of her wrist, the storm of ice needles shot forward like a gatling gun, aiming to impale Kadi’s arms and legs.
’They’re actually doing very well...
Spending time with me can’t be that motivating, can it?’
CLANG!
CLANG!
CLANG!
CLANG!
Kadi didn’t even bother casting an defensive spell as she threw her body forward into a wild roll, avoiding the primary arc of ice needles.
Three of the sharp ice shards grazed her shoulder and thigh, slicing through her tunic and drawing bright red blood, but she didn’t even flinch.
She sprung off the ground like an untamed beast, closing the distance on Eliora in a fraction of a second.
THWACK!
"No you eat!"
Kadi didn’t use magic as she drove her fist straight into Eliora’s jaw.
A sickening crack echoed through the stadium as Eliora’s head snapped back.
The stern looking ice mage went limp immediately with her crystal orb falling from her numb fingers and shattering on the dirt as her body collapsed sideways onto the ground, completely knocked out.
"SHE’S THROWING HANDS?!" Venma gasped in utter shock from the back lines!
"THIS IS A MAGE ROYALE, NOT A BRAWL!" Thalia yelled, her quiet demeanor vanishing as she stomped both boots into the arena floor.
Thalia, the Earth Shaper, raised her arms, attempting to override Kadi’s control over the dirt!
RUMBLE!
The ground beneath Kadi’s feet turned into liquid mud, sinking her down to her knees!
"NOW!
JUMP HER!" Aurelia shouted!
The tall elegant Light Weaver didn’t waste time with long incantations.
She charged forward alongside Thalia with her hands glowing with blinding solid-light daggers!

Two Mages tried jumping Kadi simultaneously while she was trapped in the mud pit as Aurelia thrust her solid-light daggers toward Kadi’s chest, while Thalia swung a heavy stone-coated gauntlet straight at her head!
BANG!
CLANG!
Kadi’s unhinged grin only grew wider...
While she was trapped in the mud, she ducked her head low, letting Thalia’s heavy stone fist graze the top of her skull, tearing skin and sending blood trickling down her forehead into her eyes!
With her eyes stinging with blood and brown earth mana, Kadi reached up with both hands, grabbing Aurelia’s wrist and Thalia’s arm simultaneously.
"GOTCHA, SWEETIES!" Kadi cackled.
THUD!
Using pure, raw physical momentum and reinforcement magic, Kadi violently slammed both girls’ heads together with a brutal, bone-crunching impact.
CRACK!
Aurelia and Thalia’s eyes rolled up into their heads instantly.
Their spells dissolved into fine dust as both women collapsed face-first into the mud beside her, completely unconscious!
Up in the viewing box, Silas leaned forward against the wooden railing, a low whistle escaping his lips.
"Damn," Silas muttered, watching the sandy-brown-haired girl wipe blood out of her eyes with her forearm.
"She’s not just a caster...
She’s a straight-up pit fighter.
Is she perhaps related to Brida?"
Beside him, Morwenna took a slow sip from her wooden mug with a wicked approving smirk spreading across her sharp face.
"I like her, Captain.
She’s got pirate grit.
She doesn’t give a damn about proper form... she just wants to cave skulls in."
Eluned, still clinging tightly to Silas’s right arm, sniffed indignantly, though even her divine eyes flickered with surprise.
"She’s far too chaotic... but her earth density is surprisingly pure for a mortal."
"Regardless, Morwenna.
Our mages are glass cannons, weren’t you teaching them physical coordination or something?!"
Morwenna’s cheeks redenned.
’I-I forgot...’
Down in the arena, the battle reached a boiling point.
Out of the original ten contestants, six were already unconscious on the dirt.
Only four remained standing: Kadi, Valeria, Lia and Seraina
Kadi dragged herself out of the mud pit with her sandy-brown tunic shredded, her arms covered in cuts, and blood dripping steadily from her head down her cheek.
Yet her brown-glowing eyes burned with an unholy light.
Valeria, Lia, and Seraina backed up into a tight triangular formation, their breath coming in heavy gasps.
"We can’t fight her one-by-one!" Valeria spat, blood trickling from her lip where a stray rock splinter had hit her.
"She counters direct physical ground attacks so I’m wiping the whole ring!"
"Valeria, wait!" Lia gasped, holding her wooden focus staff with trembling hands.
"Your mana output—"
"SHUT UP AND COVER ME!" Valeria screamed!
Valeria planted her boots wide, throwing both arms straight up into the sky.
BOOM!
A massive, terrifying surge of crimson mana erupted from her body like a volcanic pillar.
The air inside the stadium instantly spiked by twenty degrees as the melting snow outside the arena walls evaporated into white steam before it even touched the stone channels!
Hovering fifteen feet above the center of the arena, a colossal, terrifying fireball began to condense!
It grew from five feet... to ten feet... to a massive twenty-foot sphere of churning superheated flame!
The heat was so intense that the wooden bleachers in the stadium began to singe and smoke.
Valeria was attempting to summon a massive fireball over ALL of their heads to knock out everyone in the ring at once!
"DIE, YOU CRAZY BASTARD!" Valeria shrieked, her face pale from mana exhaustion as she brought her arms crashing down.
The massive sun-like fireball plummeted straight down toward the dirt floor, threatening to incinerate the remaining contestants and blast the entire arena to ash.
"SERAINA!
LIA!
DO IT NOW!" Kadi yelled, her voice cutting through the roaring flames.
It would take all of them out for sure...
For a split second, the remaining two mages didn’t attack Kadi... they reacted to the incoming apocalyptic fireball instead.
Lia thrust her focus staff upward!
SWOOSH!
A massive hurricane gale blasted out from her wand, creating a temporary air-cushion beneath the falling giant fireball, slowing its descent by a fraction of a second.
Seraina charged forward, leaping off the ground and channeling every last drop of her lightning mana into a spear.
KRA-THOOM!
Seraina’s lightning spear impaled the center of Valeria’s giant fireball, causing the condensed mana structure to destabilize mid-air.
BOOOOOM!
The massive fireball detonated prematurely ten feet above the ground!
An explosion of roaring red flame, shockwaves, and superheated wind exploded outward in every direction as the force of it all blasted Valeria, Lia, and Seraina off their feet simultaneously.
BANG!
BANG!
BANG!
All three women were hurled through the air like ragdolls by their own combined elemental backlash, crashing violently into the arena’s wooden boundary walls.
They hit the timber barriers hard and slid down into the dirt, completely unconscious with their mana reserves utterly depleted.
The smoke cleared slowly.
The center of the arena was a scorched, smoking crater of melted rock and burnt dirt.
Standing right in the center of the crater, covered in soot, third-degree burns, and drenched in her own blood, was Kadi.
She had survived the mid-air blast by pulling a dense cocoon of stone around herself at the last second.
The stone cocoon crumbled into fine dust, revealing her battered trembling form.
Kadi stood alone.
All nine of her opponents were scattered across the ring, completely knocked out cold.
The stadium went dead silent.
Kadi let out a long wheezing breath with the brown glow in her eyes slowly faded, returning to her normal sandy-brown color.
Her knees buckled under the weight of physical exhaustion and blood loss.
THUD!
Kadi lowered herself to her knees in the middle of the scorched crater.
She was bleeding quite a lot with deep gashes lined her arms, her head wound was dripping red onto her collarbones, and her mana core was completely empty.
Yet, as she knelt there in the dirt, a wide euphoric smile spread across her blood-stained face.
She raised her head toward the Lord’s viewing box with her breath coming in ragged gasps.
I won..." Kadi wheezed softly, her voice raspy.
"My Lord...
I won..."
Up in the viewing box, Silas watched her kneel in the dirt, a proud satisfied grin breaking across his sharp face.
"Aeliana, drop the barrier," Silas commanded smoothly.
Eluned, seeing the girl’s severe injuries, didn’t wait for an order.
The Nature Goddess raised her delicate hands into the air from where she sat beside Silas.
FLASH!
A breathtaking, radiant wave of emerald-green divine light washed over the entire stadium.
The gentle, soothing nature aura enveloped all ten mages simultaneously.
Instantly, the deep gashes on Kadi’s body closed up, her bleeding stopped, her third-degree burns vanished, and her pale cheeks regained their healthy color.
Across the arena, the other nine unconscious mages let out soft sighs of relief as their injuries were completely healed by Eluned’s divine touch.
Silas didn’t use the stairs.
He stepped right over the wooden railing of the viewing box and vaulted down twenty feet, landing lightly on his boots in the center of the dirt crater beside Kadi.
THUD!
Silas walked over, looking down at the sandy-haired Mage who was still kneeling in the dirt.
He reached out and gently patted her head, a warm, genuine smile on his face.
"Congratulations, Kadi," Silas said, his deep voice carrying clearly across the arena.
"You put on a hell of a show.
You fought with true grit and showed me very true potential today so you earned this."

chapters.title: Chapter 236: Ititius’s Return... Or Not
paragraphs: Kadi looked up at him, her eyes welling with sudden overwhelming tears of joy.
Hearing her Lord speak her name and praise her potential directly was too much for her heart to bear.
PLOP!
Kadi immediately bowed forward, putting her head flat against the dirt right at his boots, worshipping him profusely.

"THANK YOU, MY LORD!" Kadi sobbed happily into the dirt, her body trembling with devotion. "THANK YOU FOR THIS CHANCE! I DEVOTE MY LIFE, MY SOUL, AND MY MANA TO YOU FOREVER! I AM YOUR MOST FAITHFUL SERVANT!"
Silas stared down at her worshipping his boots, letting out a short hearty laugh as he shook his head.
"Alright, alright, cut it out with the boot-worshipping," Silas laughed, grabbing her shoulder and pulling her back up to her knees. "Stand up or at least raise your head."
Kadi sat up straight, wiping tears and dirt from her face, looking up at him with wide idolizing eyes.
Silas reached into his spatial Inventory.
WHOOSH!
In a flash of golden light, the crystalline Realm Seed appeared in his right palm pulsating with immense spatial energy and dense elemental sand mana.
"Open your mouth," Silas instructed her smoothly.
Kadi didn’t question him for a single microsecond. She opened her mouth wide, tilting her head back like a loyal bird waiting to be fed.
Silas took the golden seed between his thumb and forefinger and stuffed the Realm Seed directly into her mouth.
"Swallow it whole," Silas told her.
Part of the reason why Silas had decided that he should even assign the owner of the seed as his Second Secretary in the first place was because this seed came directly from Ititius’s secret realm.

It carried the ancient dormant power of sand and probably the blessing of that Bastard, so he had to be extremely careful about who received it and keep them right beside him where he could monitor their core development.
The moment Kadi swallowed the golden seed—
BOOM!
A massive shockwave erupted from deep within the earth beneath their feet.

The entire territory began to violently tremble as the stone walls of the Keep, the wooden workshops, the stadium bleachers, and the surrounding fields shook with a deep roaring tectonic vibration that rattled every bone in everyone’s bodies.
Up in the viewing box, Morwenna grabbed the railing to steady herself with her gray eyes widening.
"What the hell?!"
Down in the arena, a massive translucent holographic blue screen materialized directly in front of Silas’s face.
[Notice: Realm Seed Integration Initiated!]
[Your Territory Is Expanding...]
[Current Physical Boundary is Expanding by +1.0 Mile in All Directions!]
RUMBLE!
The shaking reached a crescendo.
At the northern, southern, eastern, and western borders of the Blessed Land, the massive towering Steel Weave Gates and perimeter stone walls suddenly dissolved into glowing golden particles.
They vanished completely from their original positions and instantly reappeared one full mile further out into the wilderness.
As the boundaries expanded outward by a full mile in every direction, the mysterious dense forest of black trees that surrounded the outer edges of the Umbral Basin was violently pulled inside.
THUD! THUD! THUD!

Hundreds of towering, dark black-barked trees and ancient spirit vegetation were smoothly integrated into the Blessed Land’s expanding domain with their corrupted black leaves instantly turning a healthy vibrant shade of dark purple as the territory’s [Divine Sanctum] cleansed their roots.
The total landmass of Silas’s domain doubled in a matter of seconds, adding vast timber reserves, open plains, and new possible mining veins to his territory.
And perhaps monsters too...
Silas grinned, watching the territory expansion notifications scroll across his vision.
However, before he could celebrate the domain increase—
"Ghh... AAGH!"
Kadi suddenly let out a strangled agonizing gasp.
She collapsed onto her hands and knees in the dirt with her body convulsing violently!
FLASH!
Streams of coarse, glowing golden sand suddenly began soaring out of her eyes, her nose, and her mouth... hell, even from her ears.
The sand swirled around her body in a violent anti-gravitational cyclone, expanding into a ten-foot tall towering humanoid phantom floating above her head.
The phantom possessed the broad, muscular form of an ancient Egyptian-like desert warrior wearing a golden centaur crown.
A deep ancient male voice escaped from Kadi’s throat, echoing across the stadium with divine arrogance.

"FINALLY!" the ancient voice roared, the spectral phantom laughing triumphantly. "AFTER MILLENNIA OF SLUMBER INSIDE THAT SEED, I HAVE BEEN REINCARNATED INTO A MORTAL VESSEL! THIS BODY AND THIS TERRITORY NOW BELONG TO ITITIUS, THE GOD OF THE GOLDEN SANDS—"
Before the ancient deity Ititius could even finish his pompous reincarnation speech....
PING!
Another system tab violently materialized right in front of Silas’s face, flashing with warning lights.
[Warning: Unregistered Male Divine Consciousness Detected Within Blessed Land!]
[Territory Rule Activated: Male Entities Are Strictly Prohibited Within The Domain!]
[Proceeding With Immediate Eradication...]
BAM!
Without giving the ancient sand god a single millisecond to react, an invisible god-tier hammer of territorial authority came crashing down from the sky.
CRACK!
The divine phantom of Ititius didn’t even get a chance to scream as the ancient god’s lingering soul fragment was brutally obliterated into nothingness by the territory’s rules.
The golden sand soaring from Kadi’s face instantly lost its divine luminescence, crumbling into regular harmless beach dust that scattered harmlessly across the dirt.
The violent cyclone vanished as the divine pressure dissolved like smoke in the wind.
Silence returned to the arena.
Kadi blinked her sandy-brown eyes, rubbing her nose as she let out a soft cough.
"Achoo!" Kadi sneezed softly, looking around in complete confusion.
She looked up at Silas with a sweet innocent smile. "Umm... My Lord? Did something happen just now? I felt a little tickle in my throat..."
Silas stared at her, then looked at the fading system notification in front of his face.
’...That happened so fast,’ Silas thought, a dry smirk touching his lips. ’The poor bastard didn’t even last three seconds before the Sovereign Realm deleted his entire existence.’

All of it... the territory expansion, the divine manifestation, and the instant eradication had happened so insanely fast that none of the lower-ranked girls in the stadium had even been able to perceive what took place.
All they saw was the sky glowing, the territory expanding by a mile, and Kadi successfully digesting the golden seed.
"SHE DID IT!"
"CONGRATULATIONS, KADI!"
"OUR SECOND SECRETARY!"
Across the stadium bleachers, all the regular women stood up, bursting into a loud thunderous ovation, cheering Kadi’s name at the top of their lungs!
Kadi’s face lit up with overwhelming joy.
She stood up on her feet, waving happily at her comrades, before turning back to Silas and bowing deeply.
"Thank you, Lord Silas!" Kadi beamed radiantly, her sandy-brown hair fluttering in the warm breeze of their newly expanded territory. "I won’t let you down!"
Silas smiled, patting her shoulder. "Welcome to the executive team, Kadi. Let’s go check out our new land."
The leftover coarse sand from her transformation still dusted her shoulders and sandy-brown hair, but her brown eyes were bright and glowing with a fresh crisp elemental energy.
"But first," Silas said, stepping forward with his broad hands resting casually on his hips, "let’s see you demonstrate your power over the sand."
Kadi’s face lit up with eagerness, her eyes sparkling like a child given a new toy. "Yes, My Lord!"
She snapped her fingers with a sharp sound and her body dropped low into a fluid athletic casting stance.
’I won’t let my Lord down... Come to me!’
FWOOSH!
The loose dirt and pulverized sand settled across the crater floor instantly responded to her call.
Streams of fine, golden particles lifted off the ground like swirling ribbons of liquid metal, spiraling rapidly around her forearms and wrists in miniature sandstorms.
With a quick, precise flick of her wrist, Kadi guided the sand into a tight spinning vortex above her open palm.
She shifted her center of gravity, driving her right palm forward in a sharp, focused strike.
SWISH!
The swirling vortex of sand shot forward like a high-velocity cannonball, compressing and hardening in mid-air into a solid razor-sharp spear of compressed sandstone.
THWACK!
The sandstone spear impaled itself five inches deep into a heavy wooden support beam at the far edge of the arena, sending wood splinters flying into the air.
Before the dust from the impact could even settle, Kadi flexed her fingers, and the solid spear instantly de-crystallized back into loose flowing grains.
The sand flowed backwards through the air like a golden river, swirling around her shoulders in a graceful arc before settling gently onto the earth at her boots.
"I’m done my Lord!"
"That was amazing... you sure have a lot to learn, don’t worry, I’m here." Silas said as he patted her head making her eyes shine.
Up in the wooden stadium bleachers, the crowd of women clapped and cheered enthusiastically at the fluid display.
However, as the excitement began to settle down, a boisterous ringing voice called out from the Shieldmaiden section near the top rows.

"Hey, My Lord!" one of the heavily armored Shieldmaidens called out, leaning her forearms over the wooden railing with a wide cheeky grin. "Is there anything worth competing for us heavy hitters?! The Mages got a whole Royale tournament and an executive Secretary spot! Don’t the Shieldmaidens and the Archers get a chance to show off too?!"
Silas looked up toward the stands, letting out a short amused laugh as he scratched the back of his neck.

"Not really," Silas admitted honestly with his voice echoing across the arena. "I wish I had more high-tier martial weapons to give you guys right now... but that Secret Realm wasn’t exactly overflowing with martial treasure."
The crowd of women immediately began shouting back, waving their hands dismissively in unison to reassure him.
"Don’t worry about it, My Lord!"
"We understand!"
"You’ve already given us so much!"
"We just want to fight for you anyway!"
"We don’t need rewards to serve you, Lord Silas!"
Silas chuckled softly, but he wasn’t really buying their eager attempt to downplay their own desire for rewards.
He knew how hard his frontline warriors worked every single day on perimeter defense and monster clearing.
He wasn’t the type of Lord to leave his vanguard warriors empty-handed while the spellcasters celebrated a massive upgrade.
’They’re being sweet, but no way am I letting them walk away with nothing,’ Silas thought with a confident smirk touching his lips.
He reached his broad hand into his spatial Inventory, searching through his stored loot until his fingers brushed against a heavy embroidered silk pouch.
It was the bundle of rare, high-density elemental jewels that Aeli had snagged directly from Valerius’s stash while the ancient tomb was collapsing in on itself.
Without wasting another second, Silas pulled the heavy pouch out, untied the leather drawstrings, and scooped out the cluster of glowing multi-colored gems into his broad palm.
"Catch!" Silas shouted with a wide grin.
SWISH!
He tossed the entire bundle straight up into the air toward the packed stadium bleachers!
Fourteen radiant multi-colored gems flared brilliantly under the bright morning sunlight as they scattered across the sky like shooting stars.
He had already sold one to Elora previously, leaving fourteen high-density jewels, and he didn’t hesitate for a single second to throw them directly to the crowd.
"Keep whichever one you catch!" Silas roared.
The stadium instantly erupted into a wild competitive frenzy.
"MINE!" Thora the dwarf forge-mistress roared, her compact muscular frame launching off her wooden barrel like a stone shot from a catapult.
She reached up with her thick, soot-stained palm and caught a deep crimson Fire-Garnet right out of the air with an iron grip.
CLACK!
"Gotcha, you little beauty!" Thora cackled, landing heavily on her boots and admiring the glowing red gem.
Over near the upper bleachers, Fenna didn’t even bother jumping.
The sharp-eyed Archer smoothly drew a blunt wooden training arrow from her quiver, knocked it to her bowstring, and drew her bow back to her ear in a single fluid motion.
’Mine...’
THWIP! THWACK!
Her arrow flew across twenty meters of open air, pinning a bright green Wind-Emerald cleanly against a wooden support beam right by its delicate leather casing.
Fenna smirked, retrieving her prize with a sleek, dramatic bow to the cheering Archers beside her.
"Hehe~"
Down near the front railing, Brida flexed her massive S-Rank shoulders and reached out, catching a glowing Earth-Amber cleanly with one hand.
Her heavy gauntlet snapped shut around the gem like an iron vise.
SNAP!
"A fine addition to my shield pommel..." Brida grunted with a satisfied, broad grin.
Up in the elevated Lord’s viewing box, the highest-tier women moved with effortless casual dominance to claim their share.
Eluned didn’t even bother raising her hands from her lap.
’I like that one...’
A slender emerald-glowing plant root whipped out from the wooden floorboards beneath her chair, catching a sparkling Nature-Jade mid-flight and gently reeling it back into her waiting palm.
THWIP!

Streams of coarse, glowing golden sand suddenly began soaring out of her eyes, her nose, and her mouth... hell, even from her ears.
The sand swirled around her body in a violent anti-gravitational cyclone, expanding into a ten-foot tall towering humanoid phantom floating above her head.
The phantom possessed the broad, muscular form of an ancient Egyptian-like desert warrior wearing a golden centaur crown.
A deep ancient male voice escaped from Kadi’s throat, echoing across the stadium with divine arrogance.
"FINALLY!" the ancient voice roared, the spectral phantom laughing triumphantly.
"AFTER MILLENNIA OF SLUMBER INSIDE THAT SEED, I HAVE BEEN REINCARNATED INTO A MORTAL VESSEL!
THIS BODY AND THIS TERRITORY NOW BELONG TO ITITIUS, THE GOD OF THE GOLDEN SANDS—"
Before the ancient deity Ititius could even finish his pompous reincarnation speech....
PING!
Another system tab violently materialized right in front of Silas’s face, flashing with warning lights.
[Warning: Unregistered Male Divine Consciousness Detected Within Blessed Land!]
[Territory Rule Activated: Male Entities Are Strictly Prohibited Within The Domain!]
[Proceeding With Immediate Eradication...]
BAM!
Without giving the ancient sand god a single millisecond to react, an invisible god-tier hammer of territorial authority came crashing down from the sky.
CRACK!
The divine phantom of Ititius didn’t even get a chance to scream as the ancient god’s lingering soul fragment was brutally obliterated into nothingness by the territory’s rules.
The golden sand soaring from Kadi’s face instantly lost its divine luminescence, crumbling into regular harmless beach dust that scattered harmlessly across the dirt.
The violent cyclone vanished as the divine pressure dissolved like smoke in the wind.
Silence returned to the arena.
Kadi blinked her sandy-brown eyes, rubbing her nose as she let out a soft cough.
"Achoo!" Kadi sneezed softly, looking around in complete confusion.
She looked up at Silas with a sweet innocent smile.
"Umm...
My Lord?
Did something happen just now?
I felt a little tickle in my throat..."
Silas stared at her, then looked at the fading system notification in front of his face.
’...That happened so fast,’ Silas thought, a dry smirk touching his lips. ’The poor bastard didn’t even last three seconds before the Sovereign Realm deleted his entire existence.’

All of it... the territory expansion, the divine manifestation, and the instant eradication had happened so insanely fast that none of the lower-ranked girls in the stadium had even been able to perceive what took place.
All they saw was the sky glowing, the territory expanding by a mile, and Kadi successfully digesting the golden seed.
"SHE DID IT!"
"CONGRATULATIONS, KADI!"
"OUR SECOND SECRETARY!"
Across the stadium bleachers, all the regular women stood up, bursting into a loud thunderous ovation, cheering Kadi’s name at the top of their lungs!
Kadi’s face lit up with overwhelming joy.
She stood up on her feet, waving happily at her comrades, before turning back to Silas and bowing deeply.
"Thank you, Lord Silas!" Kadi beamed radiantly, her sandy-brown hair fluttering in the warm breeze of their newly expanded territory.
"I won’t let you down!"
Silas smiled, patting her shoulder.
"Welcome to the executive team, Kadi.
Let’s go check out our new land."
The leftover coarse sand from her transformation still dusted her shoulders and sandy-brown hair, but her brown eyes were bright and glowing with a fresh crisp elemental energy.
"But first," Silas said, stepping forward with his broad hands resting casually on his hips, "let’s see you demonstrate your power over the sand."
Kadi’s face lit up with eagerness, her eyes sparkling like a child given a new toy.
"Yes, My Lord!"
She snapped her fingers with a sharp sound and her body dropped low into a fluid athletic casting stance.
’I won’t let my Lord down...
Come to me!’
FWOOSH!
The loose dirt and pulverized sand settled across the crater floor instantly responded to her call.
Streams of fine, golden particles lifted off the ground like swirling ribbons of liquid metal, spiraling rapidly around her forearms and wrists in miniature sandstorms.
With a quick, precise flick of her wrist, Kadi guided the sand into a tight spinning vortex above her open palm.
She shifted her center of gravity, driving her right palm forward in a sharp, focused strike.
SWISH!
The swirling vortex of sand shot forward like a high-velocity cannonball, compressing and hardening in mid-air into a solid razor-sharp spear of compressed sandstone.
THWACK!
The sandstone spear impaled itself five inches deep into a heavy wooden support beam at the far edge of the arena, sending wood splinters flying into the air.
Before the dust from the impact could even settle, Kadi flexed her fingers, and the solid spear instantly de-crystallized back into loose flowing grains.
The sand flowed backwards through the air like a golden river, swirling around her shoulders in a graceful arc before settling gently onto the earth at her boots.
"I’m done my Lord!"
"That was amazing... you sure have a lot to learn, don’t worry, I’m here." Silas said as he patted her head making her eyes shine.
Up in the wooden stadium bleachers, the crowd of women clapped and cheered enthusiastically at the fluid display.
However, as the excitement began to settle down, a boisterous ringing voice called out from the Shieldmaiden section near the top rows.
"Hey, My Lord!" one of the heavily armored Shieldmaidens called out, leaning her forearms over the wooden railing with a wide cheeky grin.
"Is there anything worth competing for us heavy hitters?!
The Mages got a whole Royale tournament and an executive Secretary spot!
Don’t the Shieldmaidens and the Archers get a chance to show off too?!"
Silas looked up toward the stands, letting out a short amused laugh as he scratched the back of his neck.
"Not really," Silas admitted honestly with his voice echoing across the arena.
"I wish I had more high-tier martial weapons to give you guys right now... but that Secret Realm wasn’t exactly overflowing with martial treasure."
The crowd of women immediately began shouting back, waving their hands dismissively in unison to reassure him.
"Don’t worry about it, My Lord!"
"We understand!"
"You’ve already given us so much!"
"We just want to fight for you anyway!"
"We don’t need rewards to serve you, Lord Silas!"
Silas chuckled softly, but he wasn’t really buying their eager attempt to downplay their own desire for rewards.
He knew how hard his frontline warriors worked every single day on perimeter defense and monster clearing.
He wasn’t the type of Lord to leave his vanguard warriors empty-handed while the spellcasters celebrated a massive upgrade.
’They’re being sweet, but no way am I letting them walk away with nothing,’ Silas thought with a confident smirk touching his lips.
He reached his broad hand into his spatial Inventory, searching through his stored loot until his fingers brushed against a heavy embroidered silk pouch.
It was the bundle of rare, high-density elemental jewels that Aeli had snagged directly from Valerius’s stash while the ancient tomb was collapsing in on itself.
Without wasting another second, Silas pulled the heavy pouch out, untied the leather drawstrings, and scooped out the cluster of glowing multi-colored gems into his broad palm.
"Catch!" Silas shouted with a wide grin.
SWISH!
He tossed the entire bundle straight up into the air toward the packed stadium bleachers!
Fourteen radiant multi-colored gems flared brilliantly under the bright morning sunlight as they scattered across the sky like shooting stars.
He had already sold one to Elora previously, leaving fourteen high-density jewels, and he didn’t hesitate for a single second to throw them directly to the crowd.
"Keep whichever one you catch!" Silas roared.
The stadium instantly erupted into a wild competitive frenzy.
"MINE!" Thora the dwarf forge-mistress roared, her compact muscular frame launching off her wooden barrel like a stone shot from a catapult.
She reached up with her thick, soot-stained palm and caught a deep crimson Fire-Garnet right out of the air with an iron grip.
CLACK!
"Gotcha, you little beauty!" Thora cackled, landing heavily on her boots and admiring the glowing red gem.
Over near the upper bleachers, Fenna didn’t even bother jumping.
The sharp-eyed Archer smoothly drew a blunt wooden training arrow from her quiver, knocked it to her bowstring, and drew her bow back to her ear in a single fluid motion.
’Mine...’
THWIP!
THWACK!
Her arrow flew across twenty meters of open air, pinning a bright green Wind-Emerald cleanly against a wooden support beam right by its delicate leather casing.
Fenna smirked, retrieving her prize with a sleek, dramatic bow to the cheering Archers beside her.
"Hehe~"
Down near the front railing, Brida flexed her massive S-Rank shoulders and reached out, catching a glowing Earth-Amber cleanly with one hand.
Her heavy gauntlet snapped shut around the gem like an iron vise.
SNAP!
"A fine addition to my shield pommel..." Brida grunted with a satisfied, broad grin.
Up in the elevated Lord’s viewing box, the highest-tier women moved with effortless casual dominance to claim their share.
Eluned didn’t even bother raising her hands from her lap.
’I like that one...’
A slender emerald-glowing plant root whipped out from the wooden floorboards beneath her chair, catching a sparkling Nature-Jade mid-flight and gently reeling it back into her waiting palm.
THWIP!

chapters.title: Chapter 237: A Rival Lord In The Umbral Basin?
paragraphs: Morwenna raised her right hand casually with a sphere of swirling sea-water materializing over her palm.
The floating water expanded outward, catching a deep blue Ocean-Sapphire cleanly out of the sky before condensing back into a floating orb of clear liquid.
"Hah mine!"
SPLASH!
And right beside her, Aeli gently extended her long slender fingers.
A tiny silver spatial rift opened right in front of a floating Violet-Amethyst, swallowing the gem instantly before depositing it smoothly into her waiting hand.
ZIP!
The remaining seven jewels were caught in wild, laughing scrambles by the surrounding Archers, Shieldmaidens, and even the tailor.
Loud cheers and bright, genuine laughter echoed across the entire wooden stadium as the women showed off their new treasures to one another.
"THANK YOU, MY LORD!" all the women women shouted in a booming synchronized chorus that shook the trees.
Silas smiled, turning his back to the cheering stadium.
He walked up the wooden steps toward the Lord’s viewing box where Rowena was standing quietly near the edge, holding her leather administration ledger against her chest.
Silas reached into his coat pocket and pulled out a sleek beautifully carved blue pendant... a high-tier sapphire amulet infused with compressed runes that he had set aside specifically for her.
He stepped up close and held the sparkling artifact out to her.
Rowena blinked her clear blue eyes in utter surprise, looking from the glowing blue stone up to Silas’s sharp face.
"My Lord...?" Rowena asked softly, her voice wavering slightly with emotion. "What is this for?"

"I told you I had something special prepared for you," Silas said warmly, taking her small hand and placing the sapphire amulet directly into her palm. "This sapphire amulet is carved with dual-conduit runes... It will permanently reduce your spell casting time and increase the raw force of your mana output by two times as well as give a special effect... You’ll see what I mean when you try it."
Rowena stared down at the glowing blue artifact resting in her hands.
A two-times multiplier on her gravity spells was an astronomical game-changing upgrade alongside everything else!
Tears of deep overwhelming gratitude welled in her blue eyes.
Without thinking or holding back her emotions, the usually calm and composed mage threw her arms around Silas’s neck, hugging him tightly against her chest.
"Thank you, Lord Silas!" Rowena whispered happily, her flushed face buried against his broad shoulder. "Thank you so much! I will use this strength to serve you perfectly!"
Silas chuckled softly, wrapping one arm around her waist to give her a reassuring squeeze before stepping back.
He looked around at the bright sun-drenched sky and the newly expanded horizon stretching out past the stadium walls.
"Alright, girls," Silas announced, his deep voice carrying over the crowd. "Why don’t we go check out the new distance?"
The entire population set off from the stadium, walking in a wide cheerful procession toward the outer perimeter of the domain.
The physical distance from the newly constructed stadium to the outer boundary gates used to be a relatively short five-minute walk.
But now, after the Realm Seed’s integration, the spatial landmass had stretched dramatically in every direction.
What surprised everyone most as they walked was the density of nature that now covered the newly annexed land.
Previously, the territory had been relatively barren near the outer edges... mostly open dirt paths, flat stone plains, and sparse patches of wild grass with a lot of trees.
Now, the newly added mile was overflowing with thousands of towering healthy trees.
Vast groves of dark-barked trees stretched out as far as the eye could see beneath the bright morning sun.

The leaves rustled softly in the warm breeze, and hanging thick from the heavy wooden branches were endless clusters of wild, ripe fruits... mainly crisp red apples, sweet star-plums, and plump wild berries.
Morwenna walked near the front of the group right beside Silas, looking up at the heavy fruit-laden branches with an amused smirk.
"Fresh fruit in the middle of a border expansion? I’ll take it..." Morwenna chuckled with her hand resting on the hilt of her sword.
She casually raised her left hand, engaging a subtle weave of her high-tier Tidal-Blade Arts.
SPLASH!
A gentle swirling stream of clear water shot out from her fingertips, wrapping smoothly around a cluster of the highest, ripest red apples near the top canopy of a thirty-foot tree.
The liquid stream plucked six heavy apples cleanly off their stems and reeled them back down to her waiting hand.
Morwenna grabbed one of the crisp red apples, taking a loud, crunchy bite.
"Mmm... Sweet and crisp."
She turned to Silas, holding a second fresh, dripping apple directly up to his mouth.
"Here, Captain. Taste this one."
Silas didn’t hesitate for a single second.
He leaned down and took a large healthy bite right out of the apple held in her pale hand, chewing thoughtfully as the sweet juice filled his mouth.
"Not bad at all," Silas nodded in genuine approval. "Thora and Kaelia can definitely harvest these for brewing, baking, and daily rations."
Morwenna smiled with deep satisfaction, then turned to her right where Eluned was walking with a slight defensive pout.
Without even asking or giving warning, Morwenna casually stuffed a third fresh apple right into the Nature Goddess’s open mouth.
"Mmmph?!" Eluned squeaked in surprise, her eyes going wide as her cheeks puffed out with her teeth instinctively sinking into the crisp fruit.
"Eat up, weed-girl," Morwenna teased dryly while smirking. "It came directly from tree branches, so it’s basically your long-lost family."
Eluned glaring angrily at the pirate queen, chewing rapidly and swallowing the sweet apple pulp.
But after tasting the rich natural sweetness of the fruit, her annoyed scowl slowly melted away.
She looked around at the towering purple-tinged canopy surrounding them, letting out a soft sigh of genuine heartfelt awe.
"It really is beautiful..." Eluned admitted softly, her silver-green eyes reflecting the golden sunlight filtering through the dense leaves. "The land feels so vibrant and alive now."
After a short, enjoyable walk through the lush new woodland, Silas and all the other women finally arrived at the outer perimeter boundary.

Standing tall, imposing, and majestic at the very edge of the newly annexed mile were the massive Steel Weave Gates, perfectly anchored into the earth, marking the new boundary line between the Blessed Land and the untamed wilderness of the Umbral Basin beyond.
Silas turned around, stepping onto a small stone ridge to face his entire population.
The seventy-four women gathered before him in a tight attentive formation with their eyes fixed on their Lord.

"Look at this place," Silas began, gesturing wide with his arm toward the sprawling, tree-filled landscape stretching out behind them. "The growth our territory has experienced today isn’t just because of a seed or a system reward. It’s because of all of you. Your hard work, your unshakeable loyalty, and your strength are what keep this Territory alive and I hope we can continue growing like this together."
"WOOOOH!"
"FOR THE BLESSED LAND!"
"FOR LORD SILAS!"
"WE FOLLOW YOU TO THE END!"
The women cheered wildly in unison, their passionate voices echoing through the thick forest canopy.
Silas raised his hands, smiling as he waited for the ecstatic cheers to slowly die down.
"And as of right now," Silas added, his voice changing into a serious rock-solid rhythm that commanded absolute attention, "I have even better news to tell all of you."
The crowd quieted down instantly, every single girl leaning forward with eager, breathless curiosity.

"There’s no need for any of you to ever be worried about your starting classes," Silas announced clearly, his gravelly voice carrying to every ear. "Whether you currently have an E-Rank, a D-Rank, or a C-Rank class... it doesn’t matter."
A collective gasp rippled through the ranks.
Several of the lower-ranked girls went completely silent, their eyes widening in utter shock.

"I have the ability to upgrade your classes directly," Silas declared, his golden-ringed eyes glowing as he said so. "Every single woman in this territory will eventually be elevated to high-tier forms."
The crowd stood completely stunned, paralyzed by the impossibility of what he was saying.
Class upgrades were legendary in the Sovereign Realm... things that required ancient, unobtainable shrines, divine trials, or legendary elixirs.
Tasmin stepped forward from the front line, taking the floor to stand right beside her Lord.
Her dark eyes burned with intense fierce pride as she looked at her comrades.
"Our Lord speaks the absolute truth," Tasmin announced firmly with her voice ringing across the clearing.
She held up her hands, and deep writhing shadow mana flared violently around her arms.
The black-and-silver strands of her hair fluttered in the wind as dark shadow cables coiled like living serpents around her boots.

"I was once a simple C-Rank, stuck at a hopeless plateau with zero chance of advancement," Tasmin explained clearly. "My Lord unlocked my core, elevated my potential, and made me vastly stronger. And even now... I command the shadows themselves."
Beside her, Brida folded her massive, armored arms over her broad chest. She didn’t deliver a long speech as she simply flexed her titan muscles.
BOOM!
A shockwave of physical pressure erupted from Brida’s boots, instantly shattering the solid earth beneath her feet into a crater of cracked stone.
"Me too," Brida grunted with a confident fierce smirk. "Lord Silas raised my core directly to Grand Titan Bastion status... He can do it for every single one of you."
The lower-ranked women in the crowd stared in utter awe, their hearts pounding against their ribs with wild hope and devotion.

"As long as we gather enough Upgrade Points through combat," Silas explained clearly to the crowd, "every single girl in Blessed Land will grow. But to gather UP, we need to hunt. We need to go out into the Umbral Basin and slay the beast packs roaming outside our gates."
"YEAHHHHH!"
"LET’S HUNT!"
"FOR THE UPGRADE POINTS!"
"LEAD US TO WAR, MY LORD!"
The entire assembly cheered in a loud bloodthirsty roar of pure martial excitement!
Silas immediately began organizing them into specialized field deployment teams for major hunting operations outside the walls.

"Fenna," Silas commanded, looking over at the sharp ranger chief. "You and two archers, including Elara, are scheduled to stay atop the Keep’s main Watchtower. Keep the heavy mana cannons manned and oversee perimeter defense at all times."
"Understood, My Lord!" Fenna answered with a crisp, precise salute.
"Next, Team Alpha," Silas ordered. "Tasmin, you take point... Take Elara and a squad of girls for high-speed scouting, quick-strike ambushes, and tracking."
"As you command, Lord Silas," Tasmin bowed deeply with her shadow weapons clinking at her waist.
"Team Bravo will be led by Brida," Silas continued. "Focus on heavy armor defense, frontline tanking, and clearing large dense beast nests."
"Leave it to me, Captain!" Brida grinned broadly, slapping her heavy metal gauntlets together with a loud sound.
Before Silas could announce the leadership for the third team, Morwenna stepped forward from his side with her cutlass clinking against her dark leather belt.

"Let me lead Team 3, Captain," Morwenna volunteered, a sharp eager glint in her stormy gray eyes. "It’ll be a perfect opportunity to educate the newer girls on how to properly weave Tidal-Blade Arts in actual field combat."
Silas smiled, nodding in instant agreement. "Alright. Morwenna, you lead Team 3... we’ll call it The Abyss Corsairs."
Morwenna smirked broadly, resting her hand on her hip. "I like the sound of that name, Captain."
Just as the three field teams were finalizing their squad rosters, a rhythmic thumping echoed from the forest path behind them.
Reina, the territory’s Beast Tamer, walked up leading the domain’s tamed mounts... the Blessed Wolves!
The majestic massive direwolves stepped forward into the clearing, their thick lustrous fur gleaming under the bright sunlight.
The large Alpha male Blessed Wolf known as Titan strode up to the front rank.
The scarred, imposing wolf looked over at Morwenna and lowered his massive, muscular shoulders, allowing the Pirate Queen to easily swing her leg over and mount his back with natural grace.
"Oh, Titan! You’re such a good boy... Yes you..."
Beside Titan stood his brother, Scout.
The sleek extraordinarily fast direwolf looked over at Reina, who patted his head affectionately before guiding him over to Brida.
It seemed they had bonded since the time Silas was not around.
"Alright, big guy!" Brida cheered happily, slapping Scout’s broad furry flank with a loud laugh. "Thanks for the lift!"
She mounted Scout with the massive wolf easily supporting her heavy S-Rank Titan weight without flinching.
The remaining female wolves... Luna, Nova, and Ember approached the other teams.
Luna bonded directly with Tasmin’s squad, Ember trotted over to one of the leaders in Team Bravo, and Nova stepped up beside Reina to serve as her personal combat mount in Team Abyss Corsairs.
With all three field teams fully mounted, armed, and ready for war, Silas turned toward the massive iron mechanisms of the outer perimeter.
"OPEN THE GATES!" Silas commanded, his deep voice ringing out.
HEAVE! RUMBLE!
The massive Steel Weave Gates slowly ground open, revealing the dark, untamed wilderness of the Umbral Basin stretching out beyond the territory borders.
"MOVE OUT!" Morwenna roared, drawing her silver Corsair and pointing it toward the wild trees!
The three field teams surged forward through the opening.
The Blessed Wolves sprinted across the threshold in broad, powerful leaps with their heavy paws kicking up dirt as the girls cheered and waved back at Silas.
"See you later, My Lord!"
"We’ll bring back mountain loads of UP!"
"Watch over the territory, Lord Silas!"
Morwenna turned back on Titan’s shoulders, blowing Silas a playful lingering kiss over her shoulder with a wink as her squad disappeared into the dense forest depth.
Silas stood at the open gate, waving them off with a proud, satisfied smile.
Remaining behind with him at the gate were Eluned and Aeli, who immediately attached themselves to his left and right arms like affectionate anchors.
Standing beside his right leg was Valkyrie, the Alpha’s mate, who gently nudged her large, soft head against his thigh.
Silas smiled, reaching down with his broad hand and gently patting Valkyrie behind her ears.
"You’re a really good girl..." The female wolf let out a satisfied huff, leaning into his warm touch.
Silas looked out at the peaceful, sunlit forest surrounding the Keep, turning his head toward Aeli and Eluned with a relaxed, cheerful grin.
"Well," Silas chuckled softly, "Who wants to explore the trees some mo—"
PING!
Before he could even finish his sentence, an urgent blood-red notification violently materialized right in front of his eyes.
The crimson screen flashed.
[A Rival Lord of the Territory known as ’The Unmovable Wall’ has entered your area of the Umbral Basin!]
Silas froze.
His relaxed smile completely vanished, his golden-ringed eyes narrowing into sharp slits as he stared at the warning text.
’Fuck.’
