"our onboard food rations are thinning down quite a bit, and we desperately need to restock our pantries... especially to feed two hundred hungry soldiers for the entire week leading up to our Lord War..."
Vespera smiled warmly across the white tablecloth, her deep purple eyes shining with a calm accommodating light as she looked at Lord Sky.
She raised her single right hand, offering a gracious gesture toward his mobile fortress.
"You really don’t have to worry about that at all, Lord Sky," Vespera said smoothly, her voice projecting effortless hospitality.
"I would be more than happy to handle your army’s feeding arrangements...

I can have my kitchen staff and my master chef cook up a massive feast using our own stored supplies, and I’ll personally assign a detachment of my soldiers to transport the rations directly out here to your camp every day leading up to the war."
As Vespera spoke those polite words, inside her mind, Silas was ruthlessly dissecting the situation.

’I’m trying to see just how stupid this guy actually is,’ Silas thought with his internal voice stripped of all feminine softness, replaced by the sharp edge of a Lord. ’Will he actually agree blindly to that whole proposal?’
Silas didn’t necessarily consider Sky to be a complete idiot.

The man hadn’t survived for years as an undefeated Classic Lord by being a total fool but if Silas were in Sky’s position... standing on foreign soil, preparing to fight a high-stakes Lord War... he wouldn’t adhere to any kind of polite buttering up, no matter how beautiful or charming the opposing Lord appeared on stream.
More importantly, Silas would never put his own people on the line without their explicit permission just to seal a trade deal or look good for an online audience.
These soldiers weren’t just AI NPCs or disposable background meat-shields; they were living breathing human beings who had entrusted their lives to his banner.
’At the end of the day,’ Silas reflected silently behind his violet-eyed disguise, ’Sky is a good Lord.
He cares about his troops, and he doesn’t slaughter the weak but he is not the kind of Lord I aspire to be.
His priorities are split between his survival and his entertainment broadcast.’
Sky paused, sitting back in his padded leather chair.
He raised his gauntleted hand, offering a respectful, polite nod of his masked head as he firmly declined the offer.
"I appreciate the extraordinary generosity, Lord Vespera, but I must politely reject that request," Sky explained with his voice broadcasting clearly through his alloy mask.
"In the past, during my early travels across the outer sectors, rival guilds and hostile Lords tried poisoning my war-band using disguised ’gift rations’ and laced hospitality feasts.
Now... while I know with certainty that a Lord of your standing wouldn’t attempt something so dishonorable, as the leader of this mobile fortress, I still have to be completely sure.
My troops’ safety comes first."
Vespera’s smile softened, her posture exuding understanding as she nodded.
"It is completely right for you to worry about your people, Lord Sky," Vespera reassured him smoothly.
"If prepared meals are a security risk then it isn’t an issue at all.

Instead of cooked food, I can have my hunters go out into the basin, harvest fresh, untouched game, and bring the raw unbutchered carcasses right over to your camp so your own chefs can inspect and prepare the meat themselves."
Sky shook his head again, waving his hand in a relaxed gesture.
"Even with raw game, I would prefer to keep our supply chain entirely internal," Sky rejected politely once more.
"It would be much better for us if we got more of an authentic feel for this local territory by hunting the regional monsters ourselves.
In fact... since you know the terrain, I would like to ask you to act as our personal guide for today’s hunt, Lord Vespera.
Take us to a viable hunting ground where we can harvest enough meat to feed my two-hundred-man army."
Inside her mind, Silas felt a sudden spike of irritation.
’Fucking hell...’ Silas thought bitterly.

chapters.title: Chapter 245: Negotiations Between Lords [IV / Bonus - ]
paragraphs: Right now, Silas knew his core was strong... his Gold Core and his newly acquired spell scrolls made him a lethal powerhouse but he was still not as strong as he ultimately wanted to be before facing the global stage.
Giving the entire world a live high-definition show of their immediate territorial ecosystem, their combat tactics, and their local hunting grounds was really not a wise idea.
It risked exposing crucial data to corporate analysts watching the stream.
But then again... what real choice did he have? He couldn’t refuse without looking suspicious or cowardly in front of millions of live viewers.
Noticing a brief micro-second flash of reluctance in Vespera’s violet eyes, Sky leaned forward over the table, sweetening the deal with a high-value trade proposition.

"I understand that acting as a field guide for a rival army takes up your valuable time, Lord Vespera," Sky offered smoothly, his business acumen shining through. "So let’s make it a mutual exchange. If you let us hunt in your outer borders and guide my team long enough to secure today’s meat supply... I will open up my private storage vaults for direct trade. I am willing to trade rare, high-density alloy ingots that I acquired directly from the Central Lord City in the Sovereign Realm... materials you cannot mine in these outer basins. And not only that... I will also include refined spiritual catalysts and architectural resources that can only be found in the central continental zones."
Vespera let out a soft, delicate sigh, her shoulders dropping slightly as a resigned, graceful smile appeared on her lips.

"Why not?" Vespera agreed softly. "You need to show a good broadcast to your viewers, right? And those Central City alloys would do wonders for my forge. Alright then... let’s go. I’ll be your guide today."
She leaned forward slightly with her purple eyes locking onto his silver mask with a sharp uncompromising authority that reminded everyone watching that she was still a Lord.

"However... before we step foot into the woods, we need to establish a strict boundary rule," Vespera declared firmly. "From this moment until our official Lord War commences one week from now, you and your entire mobile army are strictly prohibited from coming anywhere near the actual borders of the Blessed Land. You remain here at this outer clearing. Is that understood?"
Sky nodded without a second of hesitation. "That is perfectly fair. I agree to those terms. We stay right here until war day."
Up above the mahogany table, the five hovering brass camera drones buzzed softly, transmitting the agreement live to the global network.

The stream chat overlaying Sky’s HUD instantly filled with a wave of disappointed sad emojis from viewers who had been desperately hoping for an immediate sneaky glimpse inside Vespera’s mysterious city:
[@GamerGod99: Aw man! No early tour of Blessed Land?! 😭]
[@SovereignWatcher: Makes sense, she’s protecting her domain secrets until the war starts!]
[@NoobMaster69: Vespera is so smart bro, don’t let Sky scout your walls early!]
[@PVP_Legend: Sad we gotta wait a whole week to see her place from the cameras, but respect the rules! 🛡️]
[@ValoriaFan: Fair trade! Central City alloys for a hunting tour is massive profit!]
[@StreamLover: She’s protecting her girls! Best Lord ever! ❤️]
While Sky read through his chat’s reactions, Silas was busy running complex architectural calculations inside his own mind.

’Not to mention,’ Silas thought pragmatically, his mind projecting blueprints over his mental map of the Keep, ’I also have to gather enough stone, timber, and iron over this next week to construct an entire new residential barracks complex for the seventy-two ladies I’m going to be receiving after I win this match.’
Despite Sky’s undefeated record and his massive mobile fortress, Silas felt remarkably rock-solidly confident in winning this upcoming Lord War.

’He might be a veteran Classic Lord with years of combat experience and a massive streaming bankroll...’ Silas thought, an inward confident smirk forming behind his female disguise’s lips. ’But does Lord Sky possess two SSS-Rank primordial divine beings living inside his bedroom?’
’I think not!’
Vespera pushed her chair back with her single right hand, standing up gracefully from the white tablecloth.
She looked down at Sky, who was also rising to his feet.

"Since we’re going hunting for a two-hundred-man army," Vespera instructed smoothly, "you shouldn’t bring your entire army into the dense trees... It will cause too much spatial noise and scare off the high-tier game. Bring a select, compact squad of your best people with you today."
Sky nodded in agreement, resting his hand on his sword belt. "Good point. I’ll bring along a four-person strike team today."
He looked back toward his standing ranks, making a quick selection.
He decided to bring along the exact two female Heroes that he had pledged to transfer over to Vespera’s command if she won the Lord War, along with two elite female wind mages from his standing army.
This would give Vespera a chance to see her potential future subordinates in action, while also providing high-speed mobility for the hunt.
"Step forward!" Sky commanded, turning toward his ranks.
Four women immediately stepped out from the formation, marching up to the mahogany table and standing at attention in a neat line.
All four of them wore the dark mythril-reinforced tactical uniforms and heavy leather cloaks bearing the glowing iron emblem of ’The Unmovable Wall.’
Sky gestured proudly toward the first two women standing on the left.
"Allow me to introduce the two Heroes I promised to your terms," Sky announced clearly. "First is our silver-haired Demi-Human Vanguard."

The silver-haired Demi-Human girl who had been knocked completely unconscious by Tasmin’s reverse heel-kick earlier rubbed her sore jaw sheepishly with her sharp wolf ears twitching flat against her head as she offered Vespera a stiff, respectful bow.
"And second," Sky continued, gesturing to the woman beside her, "is my Demonic Caster Hero."
This second Hero was a striking and deeply intimidating figure.

She possessed pale, ashen skin, long crimson hair that flowed down her back, two polished obsidian-black demonic horns curving majestically from her temples, and a long spade-tipped spade tail that swished slowly behind her boots.
Her eyes burned with a deep molten gold light.
Sky let out a soft, regretful sigh beneath his mask as he looked at the horned woman.

"I must admit, Lord Vespera..." Sky shared quietly, his tone dropping with genuine frustration. "This particular Hero has faced a terrible amount of unfair discrimination among my standing troops. Because she is a demonic being, many of the traditional infantrymen fear her aura and refuse to bunk near her. Despite my orders, I haven’t been able to completely stop the backroom whispers and prejudice."
Vespera turned her deep violet eyes toward the horned demonic woman.
Her expression softened, radiating a profound unshakeable acceptance that caught the Hero completely off guard.

"You don’t ever have to worry about that again," Vespera promised her softly, her voice ringing with sincerity. "I promise you right here and now... if you come along with me to my territory after this war, you will never face a single shred of discrimination or prejudice again. You will be judged strictly by your loyalty and your strength, nothing else."
The demonic Hero blinked her molten gold eyes with her spade tail freezing in mid-air as she looked at Vespera in disbelief.
"My name is Morrighan," the demon introduced herself, her voice a deep and slightly echoing contralto that commanded the space around her.
She looked down at the mud beneath her boots with a bitter smile touching her dark lips.

"You speak kind words, Lord Vespera... but your land is literally called the ’Blessed Land.’ I am a creature born of abyssal demonic mana and dark brimstone. Blessed domains and demonic beings do not mix as your very core wards would likely reject my presence."
Vespera took two steps forward, closing the distance until she stood directly in front of the tall horned demoness.
She reached out with her single right hand, gently resting her palm against Morrighan’s mythril-clad shoulder.

"Let me tell you a secret about my territory, Morrighan," Vespera whispered warmly, her glowing purple eyes locking onto the demon’s gold gaze with undeniable conviction. "It doesn’t matter where you were born, what mana flows through your veins, or what horns sit upon your head. The very rules of my domain dictate one absolute truth: as long as you step foot inside the Blessed Land... you are blessed."
A profound breathless silence washed over the clearing.
Morrighan’s breath hitched in her throat and her molten gold eyes widened with her pale cheeks flushing a dark, burning violet as her heart hammered violently against her ribs.
To a creature who had been feared, hunted, and treated like a cursed pariah her entire existence, those words hit her soul like a tidal wave of pure salvation.
Up on the hovering camera drones, the live stream chat completely melted down into a puddle of hopeless romantic adoration.
Five specific comments instantly shot to the top of the overlay, echoing the collective feelings of millions of viewers.
[@SovereignWatcher: "AS LONG AS YOU ENTER BLESSED LAND, YOU ARE BLESSED!" 😭❤️]
[@GamerGod99: I AM LITERALLY CRYING RIGHT NOW! SHE IS AN ANGEL!]
[@AnimeFanatic: LORD VESPERA PLEASE MARRY ME! I WANT TO MARRY YOU!]
[@DarkKnight_00: I want to marry her too! She just cured that demon’s entire trauma in one sentence!]
[@ValoriaFan: TAKE ALL MY CREDITS! I AM WISHING FOR HER VICTORY!]
Sky cleared his throat loudly behind his mask, trying to break the heavy emotional atmosphere before his entire team defected on the spot.
He quickly gestured toward the remaining two women standing on the right end of the line.

"And these last two," Sky introduced briskly, "are Lyra and Gale, two of our highest-ranked Wind Mages from the standing vanguard. They will provide aerial reconnaissance and wind acceleration for today’s tracking."
Both wind mages bowed respectfully toward Vespera, holding their polished wooden focus wands at their sides.
"Pleasure to serve with you today, Lord Vespera," Lyra said politely.
With the introductions complete, Vespera turned away from the table and walked over to where the two massive Blessed Wolves were waiting.
She swung her body effortlessly up onto Valkyrie’s broad silver-furred back, adjusting her balance with her single arm.
She looked down at Thora, who was standing beside the wolf with her hammer resting on her shoulder.

"Thora," Vespera instructed smoothly, pointing her chin toward the second direwolf. "Hop off Valkyrie and go join Tasmin on Luna’s saddle for this run... We need to distribute the weight evenly for high-speed woodland tracking."

"You got it, my Lord!" Thora chirped cheerfully. The dwarf forge-mistress trotted over to Luna, easily scrambling up onto the massive wolf’s hindquarters right behind Tasmin, wrapping her muscular arms around the Shadow Commander’s waist.
Vespera turned her purple eyes back toward Sky’s four-woman hunting squad standing in the clearing.
Since Valkyrie now had an empty space on her saddle, Vespera offered a generous invitation.
"We have room for one more rider on my mount," Vespera offered warmly, looking over the four women.
She focused her gaze on the silver-haired Demi-Human girl first, thinking her wolf-kin heritage would make her comfortable with wolves. "Would you like to ride with me?"
The silver-haired Demi-Human vigorously shook her head, taking two frantic steps backward.
Her eyes darted terrified toward Tasmin sitting on the other wolf with her jaw still aching from the brutal reverse heel-kick that had knocked her out cold half an hour ago!
"N-No thank you, My Lord!" the Demi-Human stammered nervously, her wolf ears flattening against her skull. "I... my leg muscles need the exercise! I prefer running on foot today!"
Vespera blinked, then turned her inviting gaze toward the imposing demonic Hero. "What about you, Morrighan? Care to join me on Valkyrie?"
Morrighan’s pale face flushed a deep violet again.

The tall horned demoness looked at Vespera’s beautiful single-armed figure sitting atop the silver direwolf, suddenly feeling overwhelming shyness at the thought of wrapping her arms around the Lord’s waist on live television.

"I... I must decline as well, Lord Vespera," Morrighan refused softly, looking away as her spade tail swished nervously behind her legs. "My demonic armor is far too heavy and spiked... I fear my shoulder plates would damage your mount’s fine saddle leathers. I will run alongside Master Sky."
Vespera sweatdropped with a massive drop of sweaty embarrassment forming on the back of her head as she sat rejected by both Heroes.
’Are my social skills really that intimidating?’ Silas grumbled internally behind his disguise. ’I’m offering them a ride on a Blessed Wolf, not a trip to the executioner’s block!’

chapters.title: Chapter 246: Vespera’s Strength [Bonus - ]
paragraphs: Seeing the awkward pause, one of the two wind mages... Lyra stepped forward with a bright, eager smile, raising her hand high into the air.
"I’ll ride with you, Lord Vespera!" Lyra volunteered happily.
She ran over to Valkyrie, placing her boot on the stirrup and scrambling up onto the wolf’s broad back, settling directly behind Vespera and wrapping her arms firmly around the Lords slender waist.
Vespera turned her head slightly, offering the wind mage a grateful, warm smile. "Thank you, Lyra. Hold on tight."
"Yes, My Lord!" Lyra beamed, blushing slightly at how incredible Vespera smelled like a crisp refreshing scent of autumn rain.
Vespera turned her attention toward Tasmin, who was sitting upright and composed atop Luna’s saddle with Thora clinging to her back.

"Tasmin," Vespera commanded clearly, her raspy voice echoing across the clearing. "I need you to lead us deep into the western basin... Take us to a hunting ground where we can find high-density game... something big enough and meaty enough to feed Lord Sky’s two-hundred-man army for the night."
Tasmin’s dark eyes flashed with sharp readiness.
She gripped Luna’s leather reins firmly with her left hand, her right hand resting casually on the hilt of her shortsword.
"Don’t worry, My Lord," Tasmin answered confidently with a fearless smirk touching her lips. "I know the exact coordinates. I’ll lead the way."
Tasmin leaned forward, pressing her heels gently into the direwolf’s flanks. "Let’s run, Luna!"
HOWL!
Luna let out a piercing hunting howl that shattered the forest silence.
The massive Blessed Wolf exploded forward with terrifying acceleration with her paws tearing through the dark mud as she shot into the dense purple tree line like a silver missile.
FWOOSH!
Valkyrie surged forward a split second later, matching Luna’s supersonic pace stride for stride.
As the wind whipped violently against their faces, Lyra pressed her chest tightly against Vespera’s back, wrapping her arms securely around the Lord’s waist.
"Whoa...!" Lyra gasped out in genuine wonder with her eyes shining as she squeezed Vespera tighter. "You’re so warm, Lord Vespera! And your mount’s acceleration is incredible!"

Vespera chuckled softly over the roaring wind, keeping her single right hand steady on the harness as Valkyrie leaped effortlessly over a twenty-foot fallen log, plunging deeper into the Umbral Basin.
Right behind the two thunderous direwolves, the remaining three members of the hunting party launched into motion on foot!

Lord Sky, the demonic Hero Morrighan, and the silver-haired Demi-Human surged forward across the muddy ground, channeling their high-tier physical mana to maintain a steady high-speed dash right on the heels of the wolves.
Beside them, the second wind mage... Gale didn’t run on the ground at all.
She raised her wooden focus wand, casting an advanced aerodynamic buoyancy spell around her boots.
SWISH!
A swirling cyclone of compressed green wind wrapped around Gale’s legs, lifting her body three feet into the air.
She hovered effortlessly above the muddy roots and thorny briars, shooting forward through the forest canopy like a flying arrow, keeping perfect pace with the running direwolves and her commander.
As the hunting party plunged deeper and deeper into the western reaches of the Umbral Basin, the environment around them underwent a drastic chilling transformation.
’This truly is a grimy, wretched place... an absolute place of nightmares,’ Lord Sky thought grimly to himself as his mythril-reinforced boots crunched against the forest floor.
The bright scorching afternoon sunlight that had bathed the outer border clearing only ten minutes ago had completely vanished.

As they crossed an invisible regional threshold inside the basin, the dense twisted canopy of black-and-purple trees overhead thickened so violently that it blotted out the sky entirely, casting the forest floor into a perpetual suffocating twilight.
Even stranger was the sudden, violent drop in temperature.
Without warning, the humid swampy air turned freezing cold.
Thick, white snow began falling from the dark branches overhead, swirling erratically through the gloomy shadows.
Snowflakes landed on the damp mud, freezing the swampwater into jagged patches of black ice.
A freezing winter blizzard in the middle of a dark swamp forest? It was an absolute ecological contradiction that defied all standard laws of nature!
Sky pulled his tactical leather cloak tighter around his shoulders to ward off the biting chill with his eyes narrowing behind his alloy mask as he looked ahead at Vespera.
Riding atop Valkyrie’s back, Vespera looked completely relaxed, unfazed by the sudden blizzard or the terrifying dark mana hanging in the air.
Her empty left sleeve flapped wildly in the freezing wind, yet her posture remained upright and radiating rock-solid confidence.

’Does she actually handle this nightmarish environment by herself all the time?’ Sky wondered in genuine awe with his respect for the female Lord skyrocketing. ’I’ve driven my mobile fortress through dozens of changing regional weather lands during my travels across the continent... but never anything as volatile, aggressive, and hostile as this! To establish a thriving top-ranked territory in the middle of a literal frozen hell-swamp... her willpower must be made of pure iron!’
Up ahead, leading the formation atop Luna, Tasmin’s dark eyes suddenly narrowed into lethal slits.
Her sensory perception picked up a massive chaotic disturbance of mana echoing through the snowy trees just three hundred meters ahead.
"Up ahead!" Tasmin shouted over the howling blizzard, pointing her shortsword forward. "We’ve reached the hunting coordinates!"
CRASH!
The two direwolves and the four running hunters burst through a dense thicket of frozen, thorny briars, sliding to a sudden, dramatic halt at the edge of a massive, snow-covered forest clearing.
This clearing was a known established Umbral Wolf pack colony... a high-density nesting ground where dozens of Tier 2 beasts usually congregated.

Tasmin had led them here knowing that even if they slaughtered the entire colony to feed Sky’s army, the basin’s rapid respawn rate meant it wouldn’t make any permanent difference to the local ecosystem.
However... the moment their eyes swept across the snowy clearing, everyone froze in utter horror.
They didn’t need to hunt the Umbral Wolves at all as most of the entire colony was already dead.
Scattered across the frozen, blood-stained snow were the mangled, half-eaten carcasses of over thirty massive Umbral Wolves.
Their black fur was ripped to shreds with their ribcages cracked wide open, and their high-tier cores forcibly ripped from their chests!
And standing right in the dead center of the bloody carnage, feasting greedily upon the pile of dead wolves, was the colossal culprit responsible for the massacre!
It wasn’t a bear, a wolf, or a swamp reptile...
It was a gigantic bird monster!
The beast stood over twenty-five feet tall, its massive muscular avian frame covered in razor-sharp metallic feathers that gleamed like polished obsidian in the dim twilight.

Its head was a terrifying fusion of a prehistoric raptor and a demonic dragon, featuring a massive six-foot-long curved hooked beak dripping with wolf blood, and four glowing multi-faceted crimson eyes that burned with pure malice.
Sensing the arrival of intruders, the colossal bird monster violently tore its bloody beak out of a wolf carcass.
It threw its massive head back and spread its gigantic fifty-foot wingspan wide into the freezing air!
SCREEEEEECH KRRAAAAH!
The monster unleashed a deafening sonic screech that generated a visible destructive shockwave.
The sonic blast shattered the surrounding snow-covered trees, blowing away the blizzard drifts and sending freezing wind whipping violently across the clearing.
Lord Sky, Morrighan, the Demi-Human, and the two wind mages instinctively shrank back with their hands flying to cover their ears as the terrifying sonic pressure rattled their eardrums.
A crimson system inspection window violently materialized directly over the monster’s towering head, broadcasting its terrifying stats to the two Lords.
[Monster]: Abyssal Iron-Weave Roc
[Rank]: Tier 3 Mini-Boss

[Description]: A primordial avian predator native to the deepest frozen chasms of the Umbral Basin. Its entire skeletal structure and plumage are reinforced with natural iron-weave plating that completely negates low-tier elemental magic and reflects heavy physical strikes. Possesses supersonic aerial velocity and generates destructive sonic shockwaves. It is very aggressive!

"HOLY SHIT!" Lord Sky shouted over the roaring wind, his eyes wide behind his mask as he gripped his sword hilt. "That’s a mutated Tier 3 Mini-Boss! Its iron-weave feathers will bounce off standard attacks! We need to pull back immediately into the tree line to avoid losing people! Set up a defensive perimeter before it takes flight!"
Before Sky could even issue the retreat order to his team—
FWOOSH!
Valkyrie didn’t retreat an inch.
With a ferocious growl, the Blessed Wolf exploded forward, launching herself straight into the clearing toward the twenty-five-foot tall apex monster.
As Valkyrie leaped into the air, Vespera reached behind her waist with her single right hand, firmly grabbing Lyra’s leather belt.
"Whoa—?!" Lyra yelped in surprise.

With a smooth, effortless flex of her strength, Vespera gently detached the wind mage from her back, tossing Lyra safely through the air to land softly in a snowdrift right beside Lord Sky and Tasmin.

"Don’t worry about retreating, Lord Sky!" Vespera called out over her shoulder, her voice ringing with bone-chilling confidence as her purple eyes locked onto the towering bird monster. "I’ll handle this one myself!"
SLIDE... CLANG!
While still riding atop the charging direwolf, Vespera reached down to her hip with her single right hand, drawing her Tier 2 silver longsword from its sheath.
The polished steel blade flashed under the twilight sky.
The Abyssal Iron-Weave Roc locked its four glowing crimson eyes onto the charging woman, opening its massive hooked beak to unleash another lethal sonic blast.
SCREEE!
Vespera didn’t wait for the soundwave to hit her.
When Valkyrie reached the edge of the blood-stained crater, Vespera planted her right boot firmly against the wolf’s saddle and vaulted straight into the freezing air.
She launched herself fifteen feet high, soaring directly toward the monster’s gaping beak.
Inside her mind, Silas was grinning with ecstatic excitement.

’Heh... This is the perfect time to test out one of those batch-upgraded Tier 3 elemental spell scrolls I upgraded!’ Silas cheered internally, channeling his mana reserves directly into his single right arm! ’Let’s see what a Tier 3 Wind destruction spell looks like in action! Hehe~!’
While suspended mid-air in front of the towering Mini-Boss, Vespera raised her one-handed longsword high above her head!

Her glowing purple eyes flared with blinding emerald-green wind magic and the atmospheric pressure inside the clearing collapsed instantly as thousands of cubic feet of air were violently sucked directly into the flat of her silver blade!
"Cyclone... Slipstream!"
BOOOOOM KRA-THOOM!
The moment Vespera swung her longsword downward, a cataclysmic compressed hurricane of emerald wind erupted from the steel edge.

It wasn’t just a simple wind slash... the spell generated a vacuum slipstream that warped space itself as the air molecules compressed into a spinning microscopic razor blade running at Mach 5 velocity.
The glowing emerald cyclone shot forward, bypassing the monster’s hyper-dense iron-weave feathers by cutting directly through the molecular space between the plates.
SLICK!
There was no sound of clashing metal and there was no explosion of sparks.

The [Cyclone Slipstream] sliced cleanly through the twenty-five-foot-tall Abyssal Iron-Weave Roc from the top of its skull straight down to the base of its claws in less than a tenth of a millisecond.
For one silent heartbeat, the massive bird monster stood completely frozen in the snow.
Then...
SPLIT... CRASH!
The entire twenty-five-foot-tall Tier 3 Mini-Boss cleanly split into two exact vertical halves.

A massive fountain of boiling hot bird blood, steaming internal organs, and hundreds of pounds of dense prime avian meat erupted violently into the freezing air, raining down over the snowy clearing like a crimson shower.
FLap... THUD!
Vespera landed lightly on her boots in the center of the clearing with her single right arm holding the longsword extended to her side.
Around her, a lingering, swirling emerald vortex of [Cyclone Slipstream] wind continued to orbit her body like a protective planetary shield.
As the massive shower of blood, guts, and heavy bird meat rained down from the sky, the spinning wind vortex cleanly deflected every single drop and carcass away from her.
SPLAT! PLOP! THUD!

Hundreds of pounds of prime high-tier meat and organs crashed heavily into the snow all around her in a neat ten-foot circle, leaving Vespera’s black button-down shirt, her trousers, and her long black hair completely spotless, untouched by a single speck of blood or grime!
She slowly straightened her posture, flipping her sword with a stylish spin before sheathing it.
SHLICK!
The blizzard wind died down as total silence gripped the forest clearing.
Lord Sky, Morrighan, the Demi-Human, the two wind mages, and the entire live-stream broadcast sitting at thirty million concurrent viewers were frozen in mind-shattering shock!
She had just one-shot a Tier 3 mutated Mini-Boss with a single one-handed sword swing?!
Vespera turned around, stepping over a massive steaming six-hundred-pound bird thigh resting in the snow.
She looked across the clearing at Lord Sky’s frozen masked face, her deep purple eyes twinkling with a cheerful hospitable smile.

"So, Lord Sky..." Vespera asked lightly, gesturing toward the mountains of fresh, steaming poultry piled across the snow. "Do you and your troops like bird meat? Or should we go hunt some more wolves to add variety to the stew?"

chapters.title: Chapter 247: Gathering Meat [Bonus - ]
paragraphs: Silas of course knew that Sky would have been able to handle it.
A Classic Lord with years of experience, a two-hundred-man standing army, and an unbroken winning streak didn’t survive in the Sovereign Realm by being helpless against a Tier 3 Mini-Boss...
However, the man preferred the cautious, heavily logical approach when dealing with immediate battlefield threats.
Sky’s first instinct was always to pull back, establish defensive parameters, protect his personnel, and avoid unnecessary risks on camera.
And that right there was another major reason why Silas was remarkably, rock-solidly confident in winning their upcoming Lord War.

Sure, a Lord needed to safeguard his people... Silas himself cared deeply for every woman living under his roof but at some point, a leader had to actually believe that his soldiers were strong enough, fierce enough, and capable enough to stand their ground and protect themselves in the face of terror.
Sky coddled his forces while Silas elevated his into monsters.
Sky took a deep breath through his silver alloy mask, walking forward across the blood-stained snow toward Vespera.
He raised his gauntleted hand, offering a formal, respectful bow of his head.

"Thank you for intervening, Lord Vespera," Sky said sincerely, his voice carrying over his broadcast microphone. "That Iron-Weave Roc would have cost me several frontline soldiers had it managed to get airborne. We owe you our gratitude."
Up above their heads, the five hovering brass camera drones buzzed wildly, transmitting the steaming bisected carcass of the twenty-five-foot Mini-Boss to over thirty million concurrent screens.
[@GamerGod99: HOLY SHIT! SHE ONE-SHOT A TIER 3 MINI-BOSS?! 🔥]
[@SovereignWatcher: DID YOU SEE THAT WIND SPELL?! THAT WAS TIER 3 AT LEAST!]
[@NoobMaster69: BRUUUUH! NOT EVEN A SCRATCH ON HER CLOTHES! 👑]
[@PVP_Legend: Sky... bro... you might actually lose your undefeated streak next week! 💀]
[@ValoriaFan: A single-armed female Lord casually halving a dragon-bird! ABSOLUTE CINEMA!]
[@DarkKnight_00: That sword swing was pure art. No wasted movement, just instant death.]
[@StreamLover: SHE IS MY QUEEN! ALL HAIL LORD VESPERA! ❤️✨]
[@TacticalNuke: The wind shield deflecting the raining blood was such a flex lmao!]
[@ProGamer_22: How is her mana output that high?! Is she secretly a monster?!]
[@SovereignQueen: Modern feminism wins again! We don’t need men when we have Vespera! 💅]
Before Vespera could offer a polite reply to Sky’s thanks, the snowy tree line surrounding the clearing suddenly erupted with a chorus of furious bloodthirsty snarls!
HOWL! GRRRR!
The remaining members of the Umbral Wolf colony... over two dozen massive black-furred shadow beasts who had been hiding from the Roc surged out from the dark briars.
Seeing the apex predator dead, the starving wolves charged into the clearing from all sides with their red eyes fixed on the human intruders.
Before Vespera could even raise her silver sword, and before Lord Sky or his wind mages could cast a single defensive barrier—
STOMP!
Tasmin moved!
The S-Rank Shadow Commander stepped forward, her dark eyes flashing with cold mana.
She didn’t draw her shortswords as she simply slammed her left heel into the frozen dirt and flexed her fingers.
SWOOSH! SWOOSH! SWOOSH!
Dozens of thick writhing, pitch-black shadow tendrils erupted violently out of the snow beneath the charging wolf pack.
The dark cables whipped through the freezing air like intelligent, striking vipers.
THWACK! CRACK! SNAP!
In less than two seconds of brutal efficiency, Tasmin’s shadow tendrils pierced the skulls and crushed the cervical vertebrae of all twenty-four charging Umbral Wolves simultaneously.
The beasts went limp instantly, collapsing into the snow without uttering a single yelp.
Without breaking her rhythm, Tasmin swept her hand across the clearing.
FWOOSH!

The writhing shadow tendrils wrapped tightly around the thirty newly slain wolf carcasses, the previous mangled wolf remains, and the two massive halves of the twenty-five-foot Abyssal Iron-Weave Roc.

With a effortless heave of her S-Rank shadow authority, Tasmin dragged hundreds of thousands of pounds of meat, fur, and bone across the snow, dumping everything into a neat towering mountain of raw game right in front of Lord Sky.
Sky stared at the mountain of high-tier meat with his jaw dropping behind his mask.
He looked over at Tasmin, then quickly gestured toward the scattered, blood-stained avian bones protruding from the Roc’s severed torso.

"Could... could you gather the dense bones as well, Commander Tasmin?" Sky requested politely, his eyes shining with logistical appreciation. "Those iron-weave skeletal plates are exceptional forging material."
Tasmin flicked her wrist.
A shadow tendril cleanly ripped the ribcage and spinal columns from the Roc, depositing the gleaming metallic bones neatly atop the meat pile.
"There," Tasmin stated coolly, crossing her arms over her chest.
"Thank you, Commander..." Sky said warmly. He stepped up to the massive mountain of carcasses, placing his open palm against the frozen flesh.
FLASH!
With a deep hum of spatial displacement, the entire multi-ton pile of meat, fur, organs, and iron-weave bone vanished into thin air, sucked cleanly directly into Sky’s Lord Inventory.
Sky turned around to face his four-person hunting squad... the Demi-Human girl, the horned demoness Morrighan, Lyra, and Gale.
"We’ve secured enough high-density meat and forging bone to sustain the entire mobile fortress for a month." Sky announced proudly.
The four women immediately snapped to attention, bowing their heads deeply toward Vespera and Tasmin.
Even though Sky’s team had been completely stripped of the opportunity to actually draw their weapons or engage in battle, their faces were filled with profound overwhelming gratitude.
Surviving a Tier 3 Basin clearing without shedding a single drop of their own blood or losing a comrade was a priceless gift in the Sovereign Realm.
"Thank you for the hunt, Lord Vespera!" the four women chimed in unison.
While they bowed, Vespera casually flicked her eyes toward the upper right corner of her vision, pulling up her system tab to check on her passive gains.
When her eyes landed on her current Upgrade Points (UP) balance, Silas almost choked on his own saliva inside his female disguise.
[Current UP Balance: 640 UP!]
’Holy shit!’ Silas thought, his violet eyes widening slightly as he stared at the rapidly ticking counter. ’The field teams back at the Keep are going beast mode!’

While he had been out here playing diplomatic tour guide, Morwenna’s Abyss Corsairs, Brida’s Team Bravo, and the rest of Tasmin’s team had been butchering the monster packs surrounding their newly annexed mile.
They had already skyrocketed his balance to 640 UP...
At this aggressive, relentless clearing pace, it was only a matter of hours until the territory crossed the critical 1,000 UP threshold.
’Once we hit a thousand points,’ Silas calculated rapidly. ’I’ll have enough raw system currency to batch-upgrade two more core personnel directly to S-Rank status!’
Vespera’s violet eyes flickered thoughtfully as Silas weighed his roster options.

’Aeli and Rowenna,’ Silas decided firmly in his thoughts. ’Those two are currently the most equipped and vital spellcasters in my group. Elevating Aeli’s spatial power and Rowenna’s magic to S-Rank will give us unbreakable field dominance. After those two are secured, I can focus on raising Fenna and the rest of the girls bit by bit.’
Silas let out a silent, mental exhale, feeling the mounting crushing weight of his territorial responsibilities.

’We also desperately need to reserve several hundred UP to systematically upgrade the physical defensive structures and barracks I plan on constructing this week... there are truly way too many things to do, and never enough time or points to do them all.’
His mind shifted back to the upcoming Lord War against Sky.
When that war commenced in seven days, Sky’s floating camera drones would be deployed high above the battlefield, while long-range broadcast relays oversaw both territories from the sky.

Silas wanted the Blessed Land to look like an actual awe-inspiring high-tier paradise worthy of its name on that global broadcast and the vast sprawling groves of dark purple trees they had annexed this morning most certainly helped elevate their scenic prestige.
’Still...’ Silas thought inwardly with a wry smirk. ’I really wasn’t prepared to start accommodating and negotiating with world-famous Classic Lords this early in my development cycle.’
Sky adjusted his cloak against the biting blizzard wind, turning toward Vespera with a polite nod.

"The weather in this sector is deteriorating rapidly, and we’ve secured our objective," Sky stated sensibly. "I request that we head back to the border clearing and return to my mobile territory, Lord Vespera."
"Agreed," Vespera replied smoothly.
She walked over to Valkyrie, reaching up with her single right hand to gently pat the massive Alpha wolf mate along her thick golden-furred neck.
GRRR-RUMBLE...
Valkyrie leaned her heavy majestic head into Vespera’s touch, letting out a deep, vibrating growl of pure affectionate joy that made the snow on the surrounding branches tremble.
Vespera swung her leg over the saddle, settling onto the wolf’s back.
Seeing that Lyra, the wind mage, was preparing to mount up behind her again but Vespera paused.
Before Lyra could take a step, the silver-haired Demi-Human girl who had previously refused to ride out of sheer terror of Tasmin suddenly stepped forward from Sky’s group.
Her wolf ears twitched nervously against her silver hair, her pale face flushed with shy determination as she bowed her head toward Vespera.
"U-Um... Lord Vespera?" the Demi-Human girl stammered softly, her tail swishing behind her skirt. "If... if the offer is still open... may I request to join you on your mount for the return ride?"
Vespera blinked her luminous purple eyes, then smiled warmly, gesturing toward the empty space on Valkyrie’s saddle behind her waist.
"Of course you can," Vespera agreed graciously. "Come on up."
The Demi-Human girl beamed with relief and excitement.
She scrambled up onto Valkyrie’s broad back, settling directly behind Vespera and wrapping her arms timidly around the female Lord’s slender waist.
"Thank you, My Lord," the girl whispered, blushing as she felt the comforting, radiating warmth of Vespera’s body against her chest.
"Hold on tight everyone!" Vespera commanded.
With all riders secure... Thora clinging to Tasmin atop Luna, Lyra and Gale preparing their aerial wind-glide spells, and Sky running alongside them... the two massive wolves spun around in the snow.
HOWL!

With a thunderous burst of speed, the direwolves exploded out of the frozen clearing, sprinting back through the dark, purple-leafed woods toward the western border before the deeper monsters of the Umbral Basin could catch their scent.
[An Hour Later, Back at the western border clearing...]
Inside the secure, high-walled courtyard of ’The Unmovable Wall’s’ colossal, three-story mobile fortress, an incredible culinary operation was underway.
In the center of the iron-plated camp, Sky’s field chefs had set up massive, roaring roasting spits and heavy iron cauldrons.
The high-density meat of the Umbral Wolves and the rich metallic marrow bones of the Abyssal Iron-Weave Roc were already being butchered, seasoned, and slow-cooked over open blue-flame mana burners.
Lord Sky stood beside the roaring cauldrons, personally explaining his war-band’s specialized preservation and seasoning process to Vespera, Tasmin, and Thora.

"The secret to preparing high-tier game isn’t just searing the flesh," Sky explained, gesturing toward a chef who was generously rubbing a deep red, aromatic powder across a massive wolf flank. "Because monsters in this region absorb dense dark environmental mana, their meat can taste bitter and tough if cooked raw. We use a specialized blend of sun-dried Valorian chili spices, crushed star-garlic, and crystallized sea-salt to neutralize the dark mana and tenderize the muscle fibers."
As the fats melted and dripped onto the blue flames, a mouth-watering, intoxicating whiff of rich, spicy, savory barbecue drifted across the entire iron courtyard.
Tasmin and Thora stood near the cauldrons, their eyes wide in genuine culinary awe as they inhaled the incredible aroma.

’That smell is amazing...’ Tasmin thought, her nostrils flaring slightly as her mind evaluated the seasoning blend. ’Though... to be completely objective, Kaelia could easily cook a dish ten times better than this without needing a single grain of Valorian spice. Her Master Chef class is divinity.’
Beside her, Thora silently nodded in agreement, thinking the exact same thing about their Keep’s resident culinary goddess.
However, both women were far too intelligent, disciplined, and polite to mention their own territory’s superior cooking out loud in front of a rival Lord and his millions of live stream viewers.
They simply maintained respectful and impressed expressions.
Sky noticed their genuine intrigue and the way Vespera’s purple eyes lingered on the spice tables.
A warm generous smile spread across his face beneath his alloy mask.
He turned toward his head quartermaster, snapping his fingers.

"Quartermaster! Pack up a full, master-tier wooden chest of our finest Valorian spice blends, crushed star-garlic, and preserved seasonings. Prepare it as an immediate diplomatic gift for Lord Vespera!"

Tasmin moved!
The S-Rank Shadow Commander stepped forward, her dark eyes flashing with cold mana.
She didn’t draw her shortswords as she simply slammed her left heel into the frozen dirt and flexed her fingers.
SWOOSH!

SWOOSH!
Dozens of thick writhing, pitch-black shadow tendrils erupted violently out of the snow beneath the charging wolf pack.
The dark cables whipped through the freezing air like intelligent, striking vipers.
THWACK!
CRACK!
SNAP!
In less than two seconds of brutal efficiency, Tasmin’s shadow tendrils pierced the skulls and crushed the cervical vertebrae of all twenty-four charging Umbral Wolves simultaneously.
The beasts went limp instantly, collapsing into the snow without uttering a single yelp.
Without breaking her rhythm, Tasmin swept her hand across the clearing.
FWOOSH!

The writhing shadow tendrils wrapped tightly around the thirty newly slain wolf carcasses, the previous mangled wolf remains, and the two massive halves of the twenty-five-foot Abyssal Iron-Weave Roc.

With a effortless heave of her S-Rank shadow authority, Tasmin dragged hundreds of thousands of pounds of meat, fur, and bone across the snow, dumping everything into a neat towering mountain of raw game right in front of Lord Sky.
Sky stared at the mountain of high-tier meat with his jaw dropping behind his mask.
He looked over at Tasmin, then quickly gestured toward the scattered, blood-stained avian bones protruding from the Roc’s severed torso.
"Could... could you gather the dense bones as well, Commander Tasmin?" Sky requested politely, his eyes shining with logistical appreciation.
"Those iron-weave skeletal plates are exceptional forging material."
Tasmin flicked her wrist.
A shadow tendril cleanly ripped the ribcage and spinal columns from the Roc, depositing the gleaming metallic bones neatly atop the meat pile.

He stepped up to the massive mountain of carcasses, placing his open palm against the frozen flesh.
FLASH!
