chapters.title: Chapter 248: Trading Alcohol [Bonus - ]
paragraphs: "Right away, Lord Sky!" the quartermaster barked.
Within minutes, two soldiers carried over a heavy and beautifully polished teakwood box bound in brass ironwork, setting it down gently at Vespera’s boots.
The chest was packed to the brim with expensive, rare culinary spices that would cost hundreds of thousands of credits on the open market back home.
Vespera offered Sky a breathtaking radiant smile, bowing her head gracefully.
"You are far too generous, Lord Sky," Vespera thanked him warmly. She placed her single right hand against the brass latch of the teakwood box.
FLASH!
With a subtle spatial shimmer, the massive box of luxury spices vanished cleanly into her private Lord Inventory.
As the loot disappeared into his storage, inside his mind, Silas let out a deep internal sigh.

’Damn...’ Silas thought, shaking his head in silent disbelief behind his female disguise. ’Do pretty women really just get all this expensive shit handed to them for free in the real world?! I’m literally just standing here, breathing, acting slightly shy, and smiling... and this famous Classic Lord is just throwing crates of luxury butter cookies and priceless master-tier spices directly into my inventory! If I were out here as Silas Graves in my normal male body, I’d have to barter my ass off or trade blood and iron just to get a single grain of salt out of this guy!’
Silas couldn’t help but smirk inwardly.
’This female Lord disguise is the greatest economic cheat code in the entire Sovereign Realm!’

"Come along, Lord Vespera," Sky spoke up, interrupting Silas’s internal revelation as he gestured toward the massive iron doors leading into the lower belly of his mobile rig. "Let me show you to our private storage vaults so we can select those Central City alloy ingots we discussed earlier."
Sky led Vespera, Tasmin, and Thora up the wide iron ramp and into the interior of the moving fortress.

They walked down a wide steam-heated corridor lined with reinforced mythril pipes and mechanical gears, eventually arriving at the heavy vault-like entrance of the mobile territory’s central forge and storage armory.
The heat inside the corridor was intense, smelling strongly of molten metal, coal smoke, and quenching oil.
As they approached the open forge doors, a short, incredibly stocky, and powerfully built figure marched out of the smithing bay, wiping grease and soot from her forehead with a heavy leather towel.
It was a female dwarf!
She was built remarkably similar to Thora... featuring the same broad, muscular shoulders, compact stature, and calloused master-smith hands.

However, unlike Thora’s messy, dark braided hair, this new dwarf woman possessed a wild, flowing mane of bright golden-blond hair tied back in a thick warrior’s ponytail, and her eyes burned with a fiery competitive sapphire-blue light.
The moment the blond dwarf stepped into the hallway, she froze. Her sapphire eyes locked directly onto Thora’s brown eyes.
Thora stopped dead in her tracks as well, staring back at the blond dwarf.

For three solid seconds, the two dwarf women stood five feet apart in the middle of the iron corridor, glaring at one another with an intense rivalry that made the heat in the hallway spike by ten degrees.

Then, in perfect, uncanny synchronization, both dwarves let out a loud, dismissive sound, turned their heads away from one another, and shook their heads with exaggerated sighs of mutual exasperation.
"Hmph!"
Vespera raised an elegant, curious eyebrow, looking between her own forge-mistress and the blond smith. "Thora? Do you know her?"
Thora crossed her thick arms over her chest, grumbling around her toothy jaw.
"Unfortunately, Vespera... I do," Thora introduced grumpily, pointing a thumb at the blond dwarf. "This loud, arrogant, golden-haired hammer-slinger is my estranged older sister... Brenna."
Hearing her name, Brenna puffed out her broad chest with immense unshakeable pride, resting her heavy mythril forging hammer proudly against her shoulder.

"That’s right! I am Brenna!" the blond dwarf proclaimed in a booming, confident voice that rattled the hallway pipes. "I am the Master Dwarven Smith of ’The Unmovable Wall’! While my little sister Thora was busy hiding away in dark caves banging on scrap iron, I was mastering the high-tier, multi-layered alloy techniques of the Central Lord City!"

"Who are you calling scrap iron, you blond anvil-head?!" Thora roared back instantly, baring her teeth. "I just forged a Tier 2 longsword that cleanly bisected a twenty-five-foot Boss monster this afternoon!"
"Luck! Pure elemental luck!" Brenna scoffed arrogantly.
Before the two dwarven sisters could devolve into a full-blown hall-destroying brawl, Lord Sky stepped smoothly between them with a warm laugh, patting Brenna gently on her armored shoulder.
"Easy now, Brenna," Sky greeted his master smith cheerfully. "We have honored guests today. Unlock the primary storage vaults for us, if you please. We’re showing Lord Vespera our alloy reserves."
"Hmph! For you, Lord Sky, anything," Brenna grunted respectfully.
She turned and slammed her heavy palm against a glowing runic wheel on the vault door.
CLANG... HISSSSS!
The massive six-inch-thick steel vault doors slowly ground open, releasing a cloud of cold preservation mist that washed over their boots.
Sky led Vespera, Tasmin, Thora, and Brenna into the massive, two-story private storage vault.
The interior was a treasure trove of industrial and military wealth.

Neatly stacked along reinforced steel shelving units were thousands of refined iron bars, crates of glowing spiritual crystals, bundles of high-tier monster leathers, and rows of pristine untouched architectural building supplies.
Sky walked over to a specialized velvet-lined display rack near the center of the vault.
Resting upon the velvet were several heavy, dull-grey metallic ingots that pulsed with a hypnotic silver runic circuitry.

"Here we are," Sky announced proudly, gesturing to the metal. "These are genuine True-Silver Tungsten Alloys, forged directly in the grand foundries of the Central Lord City. They possess a natural, high-density mana-conductivity that makes them completely indestructible against conventional physical weapons..."
Sky picked up one of the heavy ten-pound alloy ingots and stepped forward, placing it directly into Vespera’s single right hand as an upfront diplomatic gift.
"Please, take this first ingot as a token of my goodwill," Sky offered generously.

The moment Vespera’s fingers wrapped around the True-Silver Tungsten metal, both Thora and her sister Brenna leaned in close with their eyes stretching wide as they stared at the rare alloy with drooling blacksmith obsession.

"By the anvil of the gods..." Thora whispered breathlessly, her fingers trembling as she traced the glowing silver circuitry on the metal. "The grain structure... it’s folded over ten thousand times! The mana flow is completely frictionless!"

"Of course it is, you simpleton!" Brenna glazed right alongside her, practically salivating over Vespera’s hand. "It’s True-Silver Tungsten! You could forge a Tier 2-3 shield core out of a single bar of this stuff! It’s forging perfection!"
Watching the two rival sisters bond over their mutual metal-glaze, Sky let out a soft chuckle through his mask.
He turned his attention back to Vespera, initiating the formal trade discussion.

"As I mentioned earlier at the border, Lord Vespera," Sky explained in a serious, business-like tone, "initially, my plan was to send my own vanguard teams out into the Umbral Basin to hunt and stockpile raw meat for our upcoming Lord War. But after seeing firsthand just how volatile, hostile, and utterly dangerous the fauna in this sector is... with Tier 3 mutated Mini-Bosses simply roaming around open clearings, I refuse to put the lives of my crew in jeopardy just to fill our stew pots."
Sky gestured toward the remaining rows of True-Silver Tungsten ingots on the velvet rack.

"I am completely open to establishing a direct immediate trade," Sky proposed. "I will trade these high-tier Central City alloy ingots directly for the raw Umbral Wolf and Roc meat stored in your territory’s reserves. Name your exchange rate."
Vespera nodded smoothly with her purple eyes calculating the economic value. "I agree to the trade in principle, Lord Sky. However—"
Before Vespera could state her meat-to-alloy ratio, Thora suddenly popped her head up from admiring the metal bar, wiping a string of drool from her chin as her brown eyes lit up with a wild idea.
"Hey, My Lord!" Thora chimed in loudly, grabbing her Lord’s sleeve. "Why the hell are we just trading simple meat for these god-tier alloys?! Why don’t we trade him some of our alcohol?!"
"PUFFT—!"
Inside her mind, Silas almost violently spat out his tea.

’Alcohol?!’ Silas screamed mentally at his dwarf forge-mistress. ’Thora, you insane little pervert, what the fuck are you doing?! Don’t bring out your crazy dwarven moonshine during a high-stakes trade negotiation!’
Sky blinked behind his silver mask, his curiosity instantly piqued by the mention of territorial liquor. He stepped toward Thora, tilting his head.
"Alcohol?" Sky asked intrigued. "What kind of alcohol does Blessed Land produce? We haven’t had a fresh high-quality brew on this rig in months."

Before Vespera could stop her, Thora shamelessly plunged her hand into her deep leather utility pouch and pulled out a heavy, sealed glass bottle filled with a glowing thick golden-amber liquid that radiated a dense, intoxicating aroma even through the cork.

It was a bottle of Thora’s hyper-concentrated and infamous Blessed Drink... the exact same divine dwarven moonshine that had completely knocked out both SSS-Rank goddesses, Eluned and Morwenna last night.

"This right here, Lord Sky," Thora proclaimed proudly, tapping the glass bottle, "is our territory’s exclusive, signature brew! The Blessed Drink! It’s fermented from spirit-grain and other secret ingredients!"
Hearing that a new, high-tier alcohol was on the table, Lord Sky immediately turned toward the hallway door, shouting at the top of his lungs.
"Hey! Call in Astrid! Get her down here right now!"
Within seconds, heavy iron footsteps pounded down the corridor, and a massive, tall woman clad in heavy mythril plate armor jogged into the vault.
This was Astrid... one of Sky’s primary vanguard Shieldmaidens, and notorious across the entire mobile fortress as a hopeless heavy-drinking alcoholic.
"Did somebody say fresh booze?!" Astrid roared eagerly, her eyes locking onto the golden bottle in Thora’s hand like a hawk spotting prey.

"Sister! Pour me a cup of that immediately!" Brenna, the blond dwarven smith who apparently shared Thora’s exact same dwarven tolerance for heavy drinking demanded loudly, slamming her forging hammer onto the floor!
Sky chuckled, gesturing to a logistics officer who quickly brought over a tray of small, iron tasting cups.
PLOP!
"As you wish!"
Thora popped the cork off the bottle with a loud sound as an explosive wave of sweet spirit-grain and rich, burning alcohol vapor flooded the entire storage vault.
Thora carefully poured a single generous shot of the glowing amber liquid into three iron cups, handing one to Lord Sky, one to the alcoholic Shieldmaiden Astrid, and one to her blond sister Brenna.
"Cheers to Blessed Land!" Sky toasted cheerfully, lifting his cup.
"Down the hatch!" Astrid and Brenna roared in unison!
All three of them tipped their iron cups back, draining the hyper-concentrated Blessed Drink in one single violent gulp.
SWISH... GULP!
For one second, nothing happened.
Then—
FLUSH!
Lord Sky, Astrid, and Brenna’s faces simultaneously turned a deep beet-red.
Their eyes widened to the size of dinner plates as the overwhelming potency of the ingredients exploded directly inside their bloodstreams.

"By... by the heavens...!" Astrid whispered breathlessly with her armored knees beginning to wobble violently as a blissful goofy smile spread across her face. "It’s... it’s so beautiful... it tastes like drinking liquid gold and sunlight..."

"The... the flavor..." Brenna slurred out, her sapphire eyes spinning in dizzy circles as she swayed back and forth on her heavy dwarven boots. "It’s... it’s perfection... little sister... you... you actually cooked..."
"Truly... a divine... vintage..." Sky mumbled faintly behind his mask, his entire upper body swaying like a tree caught in a hurricane.
FLOP! THUD! CRASH!

In perfect synchronized succession, the alcoholic Shieldmaiden Astrid collapsed backward into a stack of leather crates, the blond dwarf Brenna face-planted flat onto the steel floorboards snoring like a chainsaw, and Lord Sky slumped heavily against a metal shelving unit with his legs completely giving out beneath him as he slid down onto his rear, he was dizzy and barely conscious.
Thora stood over their fallen, snoring bodies, placing her hands on her hips and throwing her head back with a wild boisterous cackle.
"AHAHAHAHA!" Thora roared triumphantly. "Look at them! One single shot of my Blessed Drink and they’re completely floored! That is the undeniable power of dwarven brewing!"
Standing a few paces away, Vespera stared down at the groggy cross-eyed Lord of the Unmovable Wall slumping against the shelves with a massive sweatdrop running down the side of her face.
Inside her mind, Silas was pinching the bridge of his nose in exasperated disbelief.

’I’m seriously not sure that trading alcohol is supposed to result in the opposing Lord and his top officers getting instantly knocked out cold on the floor...’ Silas thought weakly. ’What if his stream chat thinks we just chemically poisoned their Lord?!’

sentences.text: "Right away, Lord Sky!" the quartermaster barked.
Within minutes, two soldiers carried over a heavy and beautifully polished teakwood box bound in brass ironwork, setting it down gently at Vespera’s boots.
The chest was packed to the brim with expensive, rare culinary spices that would cost hundreds of thousands of credits on the open market back home.
Vespera offered Sky a breathtaking radiant smile, bowing her head gracefully.
"You are far too generous, Lord Sky," Vespera thanked him warmly.
She placed her single right hand against the brass latch of the teakwood box.
FLASH!
With a subtle spatial shimmer, the massive box of luxury spices vanished cleanly into her private Lord Inventory.
As the loot disappeared into his storage, inside his mind, Silas let out a deep internal sigh.
’Damn...’ Silas thought, shaking his head in silent disbelief behind his female disguise. ’Do pretty women really just get all this expensive shit handed to them for free in the real world?!

I’m literally just standing here, breathing, acting slightly shy, and smiling... and this famous Classic Lord is just throwing crates of luxury butter cookies and priceless master-tier spices directly into my inventory!
If I were out here as Silas Graves in my normal male body, I’d have to barter my ass off or trade blood and iron just to get a single grain of salt out of this guy!’
Silas couldn’t help but smirk inwardly.
’This female Lord disguise is the greatest economic cheat code in the entire Sovereign Realm!’
"Come along, Lord Vespera," Sky spoke up, interrupting Silas’s internal revelation as he gestured toward the massive iron doors leading into the lower belly of his mobile rig.
"Let me show you to our private storage vaults so we can select those Central City alloy ingots we discussed earlier."
Sky led Vespera, Tasmin, and Thora up the wide iron ramp and into the interior of the moving fortress.

They walked down a wide steam-heated corridor lined with reinforced mythril pipes and mechanical gears, eventually arriving at the heavy vault-like entrance of the mobile territory’s central forge and storage armory.
The heat inside the corridor was intense, smelling strongly of molten metal, coal smoke, and quenching oil.
As they approached the open forge doors, a short, incredibly stocky, and powerfully built figure marched out of the smithing bay, wiping grease and soot from her forehead with a heavy leather towel.
It was a female dwarf!
She was built remarkably similar to Thora... featuring the same broad, muscular shoulders, compact stature, and calloused master-smith hands.

However, unlike Thora’s messy, dark braided hair, this new dwarf woman possessed a wild, flowing mane of bright golden-blond hair tied back in a thick warrior’s ponytail, and her eyes burned with a fiery competitive sapphire-blue light.
The moment the blond dwarf stepped into the hallway, she froze.
Her sapphire eyes locked directly onto Thora’s brown eyes.
Thora stopped dead in her tracks as well, staring back at the blond dwarf.

For three solid seconds, the two dwarf women stood five feet apart in the middle of the iron corridor, glaring at one another with an intense rivalry that made the heat in the hallway spike by ten degrees.

Then, in perfect, uncanny synchronization, both dwarves let out a loud, dismissive sound, turned their heads away from one another, and shook their heads with exaggerated sighs of mutual exasperation.
"Hmph!"
Vespera raised an elegant, curious eyebrow, looking between her own forge-mistress and the blond smith.
"Thora?
Do you know her?"
Thora crossed her thick arms over her chest, grumbling around her toothy jaw.
"Unfortunately, Vespera...
I do," Thora introduced grumpily, pointing a thumb at the blond dwarf.
"This loud, arrogant, golden-haired hammer-slinger is my estranged older sister...
Brenna."
Hearing her name, Brenna puffed out her broad chest with immense unshakeable pride, resting her heavy mythril forging hammer proudly against her shoulder.
"That’s right!
I am Brenna!" the blond dwarf proclaimed in a booming, confident voice that rattled the hallway pipes.
"I am the Master Dwarven Smith of ’The Unmovable Wall’!
While my little sister Thora was busy hiding away in dark caves banging on scrap iron, I was mastering the high-tier, multi-layered alloy techniques of the Central Lord City!"
"Who are you calling scrap iron, you blond anvil-head?!" Thora roared back instantly, baring her teeth.
"I just forged a Tier 2 longsword that cleanly bisected a twenty-five-foot Boss monster this afternoon!"
"Luck!
Pure elemental luck!" Brenna scoffed arrogantly.
Before the two dwarven sisters could devolve into a full-blown hall-destroying brawl, Lord Sky stepped smoothly between them with a warm laugh, patting Brenna gently on her armored shoulder.
"Easy now, Brenna," Sky greeted his master smith cheerfully.
"We have honored guests today.
Unlock the primary storage vaults for us, if you please.
We’re showing Lord Vespera our alloy reserves."
"Hmph!
For you, Lord Sky, anything," Brenna grunted respectfully.
She turned and slammed her heavy palm against a glowing runic wheel on the vault door.
CLANG...
HISSSSS!
The massive six-inch-thick steel vault doors slowly ground open, releasing a cloud of cold preservation mist that washed over their boots.
Sky led Vespera, Tasmin, Thora, and Brenna into the massive, two-story private storage vault.
The interior was a treasure trove of industrial and military wealth.

Neatly stacked along reinforced steel shelving units were thousands of refined iron bars, crates of glowing spiritual crystals, bundles of high-tier monster leathers, and rows of pristine untouched architectural building supplies.
Sky walked over to a specialized velvet-lined display rack near the center of the vault.
Resting upon the velvet were several heavy, dull-grey metallic ingots that pulsed with a hypnotic silver runic circuitry.
"Here we are," Sky announced proudly, gesturing to the metal.
"These are genuine True-Silver Tungsten Alloys, forged directly in the grand foundries of the Central Lord City.
They possess a natural, high-density mana-conductivity that makes them completely indestructible against conventional physical weapons..."
Sky picked up one of the heavy ten-pound alloy ingots and stepped forward, placing it directly into Vespera’s single right hand as an upfront diplomatic gift.
"Please, take this first ingot as a token of my goodwill," Sky offered generously.

The moment Vespera’s fingers wrapped around the True-Silver Tungsten metal, both Thora and her sister Brenna leaned in close with their eyes stretching wide as they stared at the rare alloy with drooling blacksmith obsession.
"By the anvil of the gods..." Thora whispered breathlessly, her fingers trembling as she traced the glowing silver circuitry on the metal.
"The grain structure... it’s folded over ten thousand times!
The mana flow is completely frictionless!"
"Of course it is, you simpleton!" Brenna glazed right alongside her, practically salivating over Vespera’s hand.
"It’s True-Silver Tungsten!
You could forge a Tier 2-3 shield core out of a single bar of this stuff!
It’s forging perfection!"
Watching the two rival sisters bond over their mutual metal-glaze, Sky let out a soft chuckle through his mask.
He turned his attention back to Vespera, initiating the formal trade discussion.

"As I mentioned earlier at the border, Lord Vespera," Sky explained in a serious, business-like tone, "initially, my plan was to send my own vanguard teams out into the Umbral Basin to hunt and stockpile raw meat for our upcoming Lord War.

But after seeing firsthand just how volatile, hostile, and utterly dangerous the fauna in this sector is... with Tier 3 mutated Mini-Bosses simply roaming around open clearings, I refuse to put the lives of my crew in jeopardy just to fill our stew pots."
Sky gestured toward the remaining rows of True-Silver Tungsten ingots on the velvet rack.
"I am completely open to establishing a direct immediate trade," Sky proposed.
"I will trade these high-tier Central City alloy ingots directly for the raw Umbral Wolf and Roc meat stored in your territory’s reserves.
Name your exchange rate."
Vespera nodded smoothly with her purple eyes calculating the economic value.
"I agree to the trade in principle, Lord Sky.
However—"
Before Vespera could state her meat-to-alloy ratio, Thora suddenly popped her head up from admiring the metal bar, wiping a string of drool from her chin as her brown eyes lit up with a wild idea.
"Hey, My Lord!" Thora chimed in loudly, grabbing her Lord’s sleeve.
"Why the hell are we just trading simple meat for these god-tier alloys?!
Why don’t we trade him some of our alcohol?!"
"PUFFT—!"
Inside her mind, Silas almost violently spat out his tea.
’Alcohol?!’ Silas screamed mentally at his dwarf forge-mistress. ’Thora, you insane little pervert, what the fuck are you doing?!
Don’t bring out your crazy dwarven moonshine during a high-stakes trade negotiation!’
Sky blinked behind his silver mask, his curiosity instantly piqued by the mention of territorial liquor.
He stepped toward Thora, tilting his head.
"Alcohol?" Sky asked intrigued.
"What kind of alcohol does Blessed Land produce?
We haven’t had a fresh high-quality brew on this rig in months."

Before Vespera could stop her, Thora shamelessly plunged her hand into her deep leather utility pouch and pulled out a heavy, sealed glass bottle filled with a glowing thick golden-amber liquid that radiated a dense, intoxicating aroma even through the cork.

It was a bottle of Thora’s hyper-concentrated and infamous Blessed Drink... the exact same divine dwarven moonshine that had completely knocked out both SSS-Rank goddesses, Eluned and Morwenna last night.
"This right here, Lord Sky," Thora proclaimed proudly, tapping the glass bottle, "is our territory’s exclusive, signature brew!
The Blessed Drink!
It’s fermented from spirit-grain and other secret ingredients!"
Hearing that a new, high-tier alcohol was on the table, Lord Sky immediately turned toward the hallway door, shouting at the top of his lungs.
"Hey!
Call in Astrid!
Get her down here right now!"
Within seconds, heavy iron footsteps pounded down the corridor, and a massive, tall woman clad in heavy mythril plate armor jogged into the vault.
This was Astrid... one of Sky’s primary vanguard Shieldmaidens, and notorious across the entire mobile fortress as a hopeless heavy-drinking alcoholic.
"Did somebody say fresh booze?!" Astrid roared eagerly, her eyes locking onto the golden bottle in Thora’s hand like a hawk spotting prey.
"Sister!

Pour me a cup of that immediately!" Brenna, the blond dwarven smith who apparently shared Thora’s exact same dwarven tolerance for heavy drinking demanded loudly, slamming her forging hammer onto the floor!
Sky chuckled, gesturing to a logistics officer who quickly brought over a tray of small, iron tasting cups.
PLOP!
"As you wish!"
Thora popped the cork off the bottle with a loud sound as an explosive wave of sweet spirit-grain and rich, burning alcohol vapor flooded the entire storage vault.
Thora carefully poured a single generous shot of the glowing amber liquid into three iron cups, handing one to Lord Sky, one to the alcoholic Shieldmaiden Astrid, and one to her blond sister Brenna.
"Cheers to Blessed Land!" Sky toasted cheerfully, lifting his cup.
"Down the hatch!" Astrid and Brenna roared in unison!
All three of them tipped their iron cups back, draining the hyper-concentrated Blessed Drink in one single violent gulp.
SWISH...
GULP!
For one second, nothing happened.
Then—
FLUSH!
Lord Sky, Astrid, and Brenna’s faces simultaneously turned a deep beet-red.
Their eyes widened to the size of dinner plates as the overwhelming potency of the ingredients exploded directly inside their bloodstreams.
"By... by the heavens...!" Astrid whispered breathlessly with her armored knees beginning to wobble violently as a blissful goofy smile spread across her face.
"It’s... it’s so beautiful... it tastes like drinking liquid gold and sunlight..."
"The... the flavor..." Brenna slurred out, her sapphire eyes spinning in dizzy circles as she swayed back and forth on her heavy dwarven boots.
"It’s... it’s perfection... little sister... you... you actually cooked..."
"Truly... a divine... vintage..." Sky mumbled faintly behind his mask, his entire upper body swaying like a tree caught in a hurricane.
FLOP!
THUD!
CRASH!

In perfect synchronized succession, the alcoholic Shieldmaiden Astrid collapsed backward into a stack of leather crates, the blond dwarf Brenna face-planted flat onto the steel floorboards snoring like a chainsaw, and Lord Sky slumped heavily against a metal shelving unit with his legs completely giving out beneath him as he slid down onto his rear, he was dizzy and barely conscious.
Thora stood over their fallen, snoring bodies, placing her hands on her hips and throwing her head back with a wild boisterous cackle.
"AHAHAHAHA!" Thora roared triumphantly.
"Look at them!
One single shot of my Blessed Drink and they’re completely floored!
That is the undeniable power of dwarven brewing!"
Standing a few paces away, Vespera stared down at the groggy cross-eyed Lord of the Unmovable Wall slumping against the shelves with a massive sweatdrop running down the side of her face.
Inside her mind, Silas was pinching the bridge of his nose in exasperated disbelief.

’I’m seriously not sure that trading alcohol is supposed to result in the opposing Lord and his top officers getting instantly knocked out cold on the floor...’ Silas thought weakly. ’What if his stream chat thinks we just chemically poisoned their Lord?!’

chapters.title: Chapter 249: Tasmin’s Motivation
paragraphs: Fortunately, Lord Sky’s veteran Classic Lord constitution was just strong enough to prevent him from passing out entirely.
Grunting groggily, Sky shook his dizzy head, fighting through the blissful, spinning haze of the alcohol as he looked up at Vespera with deeply cross-eyed, thoroughly impressed adoration.

"Ten..." Sky slurred out, raising a trembling gauntleted hand toward his quartermaster while pointing at the velvet display rack. "Give... give Lord Vespera... ten ingots... of the True-Silver Tungsten alloy... right now... trade it... for that entire bottle..."
"TEN INGOTS?!" Thora shrieked in ecstatic drooling joy.

"Yes, My Lord!" the quartermaster obeyed instantly, hurriedly packing ten heavy bars of the priceless Central City True-Silver Tungsten alloy into a reinforced mythril carrying case and presenting it to Vespera!

Thora laughed maniacally as Vespera placed her single hand on the carrying case and the amber bottle, smoothly packing both the ten alloy ingots and the remaining alcohol into her private Lord Inventory.
’Haah... It’s okay at the very least.’
Sky staggered shakily to his feet, leaning heavily against his quartermaster for support as he pulled his wits back together.
Despite his dizziness, his hospitality remained unmatched.
He gestured toward an attendant, who brought over a beautifully wrapped bundle of soft high-tier fabric tied with a silver ribbon.
Sky took the bundle and offered it gently to Vespera.

"Please... take this as well, Lord Vespera," Sky offered warmly, his voice still slightly slurred but deeply sincere. "It’s... it’s a little extra gift from our personal tailoring vaults. It’s actually a collection of refined, high-tier womanly combat tunics, silk robes, and tailored cloaks... I hope you don’t find it rude or presumptuous of me, but looking at your frame... I think these clothes will fit you perfectly."
Vespera blinked her purple eyes in surprise, looking down at the luxurious bundle of womanly clothes he had just handed her.
She accepted the gift with her single hand, offering him a gracious bow of her head.
"Thank you for the thoughtful gift, Lord Sky," Vespera said warmly. "I will treasure them."
As she held the bundle, Vespera casually tilted the clothes toward Thora.
The dwarf forge-mistress immediately activated her master-smith runic inspection vision, her brown eyes scanning every single thread, seam, and button of the garments.
In a fraction of a second, Thora gave Vespera a subtle sharp nod of her head.
’It’s very clean,’ Thora thought. ’No mana trackers, no listening bugs, and no spatial beacons woven into the fabric. It’s just a genuine, highly expensive clothing gift.’

With the trade complete, the alloys secured, and their diplomacy successfully concluded, Sky and his groggy quartermaster escorted Vespera, Tasmin, and Thora back out of the storage vault, down the heated iron corridors, and out onto the muddy exterior courtyard of the mobile fortress.
The late afternoon air was cold with the twilight shadows of the Umbral Basin stretching long across the clearing.
Waiting patiently at the base of the iron ramp were their two majestic mounts... Valkyrie and Luna.
Vespera walked over to Valkyrie, effortlessly swinging her body up onto the silver direwolf’s broad saddle.
Tasmin mounted Luna a second later, with Thora scrambling up onto the hindquarters right behind her, holding her blacksmith hammer across her lap.
Lord Sky walked down to the bottom of the iron ramp, flanked by the horned demonic Hero Morrighan, the silver-haired Demi-Human girl, and several of his standing officers.
Sky raised his gauntleted hand into the air, offering a crisp, deeply respectful warlord’s salute to his departing guest.

"We wish you a safe journey back to your Territory, Lord Vespera!" Sky called out loudly across the clearing, his voice echoing through his stream broadcast to millions of viewers. "We will remain camped right here at this clearing! May the next seven days of preparation serve both of our territories well!"
Standing right beside him, the tall crimson-haired demoness Morrighan stepped forward.
Her molten gold eyes shone with unshakeable reverence as she looked up at Vespera’s figure atop the direwolf.
She placed her mythril-clad fist over her heart, bowing her horned head deeply.
"Goodbye, Lord Vespera," Morrighan spoke softly, her echoing voice filled with genuine emotion. "I will count the hours until we meet again upon the field of war."

Vespera looked down from Valkyrie’s saddle, offering Sky, Morrighan, and the entire assembled army of ’The Unmovable Wall’ one final breathtaking, and radiant smile that sent the live-stream chat into another blinding meltdown of heart emojis.
"Goodbye, Lord Sky. Goodbye, Morrighan," Vespera replied. "Train hard this week. We will see you at the gates."
Vespera turned her purple eyes forward, gripping Valkyrie’s harness with her single right hand.
"Let’s go home, girls!" Vespera commanded.
HOWL!
GRRR-RUMBLE!
Both Valkyrie and Luna let out booming thunderous howls that shook the surrounding trees.
With a synchronized surge of acceleration, the two Blessed Wolves leaped off the muddy ground, spinning around and launching themselves into the dark-leafed forest at amazing speeds.
FWOOSH!
In a blur of silver fur, black hair, and trailing shadows, Vespera, Tasmin, and Thora vanished completely into the dense depth of the Umbral Basin, leaving Lord Sky’s mobile fortress far behind them.
As the trees blurred past her vision and the freezing wind whipped against her face, inside the privacy of her own mind, Silas let out a massive and deeply exhausted sigh of relief.

’Fuck...’ Silas thought with his internal voice dropping the polite, charming female facade entirely as his mind locked fully back into place. ’I’m finally done with that exhausting broadcast circus.’
The scouting was over and the diplomacy was finished.
The enemy’s strength, their standing numbers, their Hero rosters, and their tactical mindset had been completely analyzed and recorded in his mind.
’Though I need to do more research to be sure...’
He had six days and twenty-three hours left on the clock.
Silas’s golden-ringed male eyes seemed to flash invisibly behind Vespera’s deep violet gaze as he looked ahead toward the towering stone walls of the Blessed Land rising in the distance.
It was time.
It was time to gather his SSS-Rank women, spend his overflowing Upgrade Points, elevate his Vanguard commanders to legendary heights and construct the ultimate defensive fortress.
It was time to make uncompromising preparations... for war!

The towering timber-and-steel gates of the Blessed Land loomed ahead through the twilight mist, marking the boundary line between the cold volatile wilderness of the Umbral Basin and the vibrant protected sanctuary within.
Perched atop the high stone battlements and the soaring central Watchtower, several Vanguard guards and sharp-eyed Rangers stood at their posts.
The moment their eyes caught sight of the massive-furred form of Valkyrie and the sleek frame of Luna bounding across the open plains, a ripple of excitement spread along the perimeter walls.
Fenna, standing on the Watchtower platform beside the heavy mana cannons, lowered her longbow and offered a crisp, respectful salute, her voice carrying over the wind.
"Welcome back, my Lord!"
Vespera, sitting upright atop Valkyrie’s broad back with her single right hand resting lightly on the reins, looked up at the battlements and raised her hand in a casual, elegant wave.
"Keep up the vigilant watch, girls!" Vespera called back, her smooth voice echoing softly across the stone ramparts.
Beside her, Luna came to a smooth rhythmic halt with her paws digging lightly into the soft earth.
Tasmin, sitting in the saddle with Thora still clinging firmly to her waist, turned her dark silver-streaked eyes toward her Lord.
"My Lord," Tasmin spoke with a bow of her head. "If I may have your permission, I would like to break away from the main path and return to Team Alpha’s sector immediately."
Vespera turned her head slightly with her deep violet eyes inspecting her Shadow Commander. "Oh? What’s the rush, Tasmin?"

"With Thora’s assistance and her communication devices," Tasmin explained, gesturing toward the brass crystal hanging from the dwarf forge-mistress’s utility belt, "I can establish a long-range network with Brida’s Team Bravo and Morwenna’s Abyss Corsairs out in the field. I will instruct all hunting squads to collect every single monster carcass they harvest today, rather than leaving them in the wilderness. That way, we can organize and sort the exact tonnage of raw game we will be delivering to Lord Sky’s mobile territory over the coming week."
Vespera looked at her with genuine appreciation, a warm proud smile curving her lips.
’She’s already taking the initiative on logistics without me even having to ask,’ Silas thought behind his female disguise, thoroughly impressed by Tasmin’s sharp intelligence.
"That’s a fantastic idea, Tasmin," Vespera praised her smoothly, nodding her head in approval. "Go ahead. Take Thora with you and set up the communications link... Good luck."
Tasmin’s breath caught slightly in her throat as she looked up into the breathtaking, gorgeous face of her Lord.
Hearing those warm words of praise made a subtle delicate pink flush touch the tips of her ears.
She bowed her head deeply on the saddle with her dark hair falling forward over her leather shoulders.
’I will make you proud, My Lord...’ Tasmin swore silently in the quiet sanctuary of her heart. ’No matter what happens, no matter what threats approach our gates... I will never fail you.’

While Tasmin pulled back on Luna’s reins to turn toward the western forest sector, her mind began rewinding the events of the afternoon... specifically, the tense standoff in the mud clearing outside Lord Sky’s colossal three-story mobile fortress.

Earlier today, during the intense moments of confrontation, Tasmin had quietly unlocked a newly awakened passive trait within her core... an advanced high-tier perception ability known as [Shadow-Sight Intuition].

By observing the density, distortion, and subconscious movement of a living entity’s cast shadow, Tasmin could now read the true hidden combat output of any warrior, completely bypassing illusion spells, concealment cloaks, and suppressed auras.
And what she had seen lurking within the shadows of Lord Sky’s war-band had chilled her to the bone.

’Lord Sky and his main blindfolded swordsman...’ Tasmin reflected deeply, her dark eyes narrowing into intense sharp slits as Luna trotted forward. ’Even though both of them maintained a relaxed, friendly, and non-threatening demeanor on the surface... their shadows were terrifyingly dense. The physical pressure coiled within their cores was staggering.’

Of course, Tasmin knew with unshakeable certainty that neither Sky nor his primary Hero possessed power comparable to Lord Silas when her Lord went all out and unleashed his full unrestricted Gold Core dominance.
However, Sky’s main officers were still seasoned battle-hardened veterans of the Sovereign Realm.
And worse yet... Sky’s visible army wasn’t the only threat.

While standing in that mud clearing, Tasmin’s [Shadow-Sight Intuition] had picked up at least four additional hyper-dense spiritual signatures lurking silently in the shadows beneath the mobile fortress’s iron treads... hidden Heroes that Sky had deliberately kept off camera and out of sight!
’I am still too weak...’ Tasmin thought bitterly with her fingers gripping Luna’s leather reins so tightly her knuckles turned pale beneath her gloves.
To anyone else, Tasmin’s recent evolution into an S-Rank Shadow Commander would have been the ultimate pinnacle of success.
She was fast, lethal, capable of enveloping entire battlefields in pitch-black shadow domes, and could slaughter dozens of armed combatants in seconds without taking a scratch.
But to Tasmin... being "strong enough" wasn’t nearly enough.

’It doesn’t matter that I reached S-Rank,’ Tasmin swore violently inside her mind, her heart hammering against her ribs with burning devotion. ’My Lord gave me this life. He saved me from the dirt, elevated my soul, and granted me a purpose. If a day comes when multiple Lords, global corporations, or divine pantheons converge upon the Blessed Land simultaneously... I cannot afford to merely be a ’skilled officer’.’
Her dark eyes flashed with an unholy terrifying light as a dark, liquid mist of shadow energy began escaping violently from the corners of her eyelids, drifting into the cold air like smoke.

’I need to grow even stronger... much, much stronger!’ Tasmin thought with her teeth grinding together in pure resolve. ’I want to become strong enough to take on Lord Sky, his hidden Heroes, and every single rival Lord on this continent at the exact same time! Whether it be the righteous armies of the heavens or the demonic legions of hell... whoever dares to step foot inside this Basin to harm my Lord... I want to be strong enough to hold Lord Silas safely in my left hand, while slaughtering the entire world with my right!’
CRACKLE... FWOOSH!

"Let’s go home, girls!" Vespera commanded.
HOWL!
GRRR-RUMBLE!
Both Valkyrie and Luna let out booming thunderous howls that shook the surrounding trees.
With a synchronized surge of acceleration, the two Blessed Wolves leaped off the muddy ground, spinning around and launching themselves into the dark-leafed forest at amazing speeds.
FWOOSH!
In a blur of silver fur, black hair, and trailing shadows, Vespera, Tasmin, and Thora vanished completely into the dense depth of the Umbral Basin, leaving Lord Sky’s mobile fortress far behind them.
As the trees blurred past her vision and the freezing wind whipped against her face, inside the privacy of her own mind, Silas let out a massive and deeply exhausted sigh of relief.

’Fuck...’ Silas thought with his internal voice dropping the polite, charming female facade entirely as his mind locked fully back into place. ’I’m finally done with that exhausting broadcast circus.’
The scouting was over and the diplomacy was finished.
The enemy’s strength, their standing numbers, their Hero rosters, and their tactical mindset had been completely analyzed and recorded in his mind.
’Though I need to do more research to be sure...’
He had six days and twenty-three hours left on the clock.
Silas’s golden-ringed male eyes seemed to flash invisibly behind Vespera’s deep violet gaze as he looked ahead toward the towering stone walls of the Blessed Land rising in the distance.
It was time.
It was time to gather his SSS-Rank women, spend his overflowing Upgrade Points, elevate his Vanguard commanders to legendary heights and construct the ultimate defensive fortress.
It was time to make uncompromising preparations... for war!

The towering timber-and-steel gates of the Blessed Land loomed ahead through the twilight mist, marking the boundary line between the cold volatile wilderness of the Umbral Basin and the vibrant protected sanctuary within.
Perched atop the high stone battlements and the soaring central Watchtower, several Vanguard guards and sharp-eyed Rangers stood at their posts.
The moment their eyes caught sight of the massive-furred form of Valkyrie and the sleek frame of Luna bounding across the open plains, a ripple of excitement spread along the perimeter walls.
Fenna, standing on the Watchtower platform beside the heavy mana cannons, lowered her longbow and offered a crisp, respectful salute, her voice carrying over the wind.
"Welcome back, my Lord!"
Vespera, sitting upright atop Valkyrie’s broad back with her single right hand resting lightly on the reins, looked up at the battlements and raised her hand in a casual, elegant wave.
"Keep up the vigilant watch, girls!" Vespera called back, her smooth voice echoing softly across the stone ramparts.
Beside her, Luna came to a smooth rhythmic halt with her paws digging lightly into the soft earth.
Tasmin, sitting in the saddle with Thora still clinging firmly to her waist, turned her dark silver-streaked eyes toward her Lord.
"My Lord," Tasmin spoke with a bow of her head.
"If I may have your permission, I would like to break away from the main path and return to Team Alpha’s sector immediately."
Vespera turned her head slightly with her deep violet eyes inspecting her Shadow Commander.
"Oh?
What’s the rush, Tasmin?"

"With Thora’s assistance and her communication devices," Tasmin explained, gesturing toward the brass crystal hanging from the dwarf forge-mistress’s utility belt, "I can establish a long-range network with Brida’s Team Bravo and Morwenna’s Abyss Corsairs out in the field.
I will instruct all hunting squads to collect every single monster carcass they harvest today, rather than leaving them in the wilderness.
That way, we can organize and sort the exact tonnage of raw game we will be delivering to Lord Sky’s mobile territory over the coming week."
Vespera looked at her with genuine appreciation, a warm proud smile curving her lips.
’She’s already taking the initiative on logistics without me even having to ask,’ Silas thought behind his female disguise, thoroughly impressed by Tasmin’s sharp intelligence.
"That’s a fantastic idea, Tasmin," Vespera praised her smoothly, nodding her head in approval.
"Go ahead.
Take Thora with you and set up the communications link...
Good luck."
Tasmin’s breath caught slightly in her throat as she looked up into the breathtaking, gorgeous face of her Lord.
Hearing those warm words of praise made a subtle delicate pink flush touch the tips of her ears.
She bowed her head deeply on the saddle with her dark hair falling forward over her leather shoulders.
’I will make you proud, My Lord...’ Tasmin swore silently in the quiet sanctuary of her heart. ’No matter what happens, no matter what threats approach our gates...
I will never fail you.’

While Tasmin pulled back on Luna’s reins to turn toward the western forest sector, her mind began rewinding the events of the afternoon... specifically, the tense standoff in the mud clearing outside Lord Sky’s colossal three-story mobile fortress.

Earlier today, during the intense moments of confrontation, Tasmin had quietly unlocked a newly awakened passive trait within her core... an advanced high-tier perception ability known as [Shadow-Sight Intuition].

By observing the density, distortion, and subconscious movement of a living entity’s cast shadow, Tasmin could now read the true hidden combat output of any warrior, completely bypassing illusion spells, concealment cloaks, and suppressed auras.
And what she had seen lurking within the shadows of Lord Sky’s war-band had chilled her to the bone.

’Lord Sky and his main blindfolded swordsman...’ Tasmin reflected deeply, her dark eyes narrowing into intense sharp slits as Luna trotted forward. ’Even though both of them maintained a relaxed, friendly, and non-threatening demeanor on the surface... their shadows were terrifyingly dense.
The physical pressure coiled within their cores was staggering.’

Of course, Tasmin knew with unshakeable certainty that neither Sky nor his primary Hero possessed power comparable to Lord Silas when her Lord went all out and unleashed his full unrestricted Gold Core dominance.
However, Sky’s main officers were still seasoned battle-hardened veterans of the Sovereign Realm.
And worse yet...
Sky’s visible army wasn’t the only threat.

While standing in that mud clearing, Tasmin’s [Shadow-Sight Intuition] had picked up at least four additional hyper-dense spiritual signatures lurking silently in the shadows beneath the mobile fortress’s iron treads... hidden Heroes that Sky had deliberately kept off camera and out of sight!
’I am still too weak...’ Tasmin thought bitterly with her fingers gripping Luna’s leather reins so tightly her knuckles turned pale beneath her gloves.
To anyone else, Tasmin’s recent evolution into an S-Rank Shadow Commander would have been the ultimate pinnacle of success.
She was fast, lethal, capable of enveloping entire battlefields in pitch-black shadow domes, and could slaughter dozens of armed combatants in seconds without taking a scratch.
But to Tasmin... being "strong enough" wasn’t nearly enough.
’It doesn’t matter that I reached S-Rank,’ Tasmin swore violently inside her mind, her heart hammering against her ribs with burning devotion. ’My Lord gave me this life.
He saved me from the dirt, elevated my soul, and granted me a purpose.
If a day comes when multiple Lords, global corporations, or divine pantheons converge upon the Blessed Land simultaneously...
I cannot afford to merely be a ’skilled officer’.’
Her dark eyes flashed with an unholy terrifying light as a dark, liquid mist of shadow energy began escaping violently from the corners of her eyelids, drifting into the cold air like smoke.

’I need to grow even stronger... much, much stronger!’ Tasmin thought with her teeth grinding together in pure resolve. ’I want to become strong enough to take on Lord Sky, his hidden Heroes, and every single rival Lord on this continent at the exact same time!
Whether it be the righteous armies of the heavens or the demonic legions of hell... whoever dares to step foot inside this Basin to harm my Lord...
I want to be strong enough to hold Lord Silas safely in my left hand, while slaughtering the entire world with my right!’
CRACKLE...
FWOOSH!

chapters.title: Chapter 250: Barrier Around Blessed Land
paragraphs: As those terrifyingly loyal thoughts crystallised within her soul, Tasmin took a deep, shuddering breath and clenched her right fist.
The pitch-black shadow mana coiling around her wrists didn’t just flare... it condensed, darkening into a light-swallowing void that pulsed in sync with her very heartbeat.
At that exact second—
PING!
A bright translucent blue system notification tab violently materialized directly in front of Vespera’s vision as she rode toward the Keep.
[Notice: Territorial Subordinate Achievement Unlocked!]
[Your Subordinate, ’Tasmin’ (S-Rank Shadow Commander), has taken the first step toward condensing a ’Shadow Heart’!]
[Effect: Subordinate’s shadow mana affinity, mental resistance against mind control, and growth ceiling have expanded permanently!]
Vespera’s violet eyes widened in utter surprise. She pulled back slightly on Valkyrie’s reins with her head tilting to the side in genuine bewildered confusion.
"Shadow Heart...?" Vespera murmured aloud in her raspy voice with her eyebrows furrowing.
Inside her mind, Silas was frantically searching through his memories of magical lore and system encyclopedia entries.

’What the hell is a Shadow Heart?’ Silas thought, thoroughly puzzled. ’I’ve read through hundreds of class-advancement books back at the Valoria Academy library, and I’ve never heard of a mortal shadow-user condensing organ-type stuff like that. Is that some kind of precursor trait for divine ascension...?’
Silas paused, his thoughts taking a sudden wry turn as he contemplated the future.

’Man...’ Silas mused internally with a sweatdrop forming behind his female disguise. ’It would honestly be a huge help if we managed to recruit or summon an actual Goddess of Shadow into the territory eventually. Someone who could guide Tasmin’s shadow cultivation directly...’
However, the second that thought formed, Silas instantly shot it down in his own mind with a shudder of pure dread.

’Wait... what the fuck am I thinking?!’ Silas scolded himself mentally, rubbing his temple. ’Right now, I can barely handle managing Eluned and Morwenna! One is an ancient Nature Goddess who constantly kisses me crazy while I’m sleeping, and the other is a feral Pirate Queen who uses my earlobes as a chew toy when she’s drunk! If I add another high-maintenance divine being into the mix at the Keep... it’s going to be hell on Earth!’
While Silas was silently panicking over his divine harem management, Valkyrie trotted smoothly through the inner gates of the Keep’s central plaza.
The various guards who were moving about the sunlit courtyard looked up, seeing their single-armed, black-haired female Lord returning from the outer woods.
They immediately paused their work, bowing respectfully with bright, affectionate smiles.
"Welcome home, My Lord! Your disguise looks amazing!"
"Good afternoon, My Lord!"
Vespera offered them a warm, charming smile, waving her single right hand gracefully.
"Good afternoon, girls. Carry on with your work."
WHOOSH!

Before Valkyrie could even bring her heavy paws to a complete halt in front of the Keep’s grand stone porch, a streak of brilliant emerald-green light dropped directly down from the high roof eaves above.
Eluned landed lightly on Valkyrie’s broad silver back right behind Vespera with her bare delicate feet making zero sound against the leather saddle.
The ancient Nature Goddess immediately wrapped her slender arms around Vespera’s waist, burying her face into her black-clad shoulder and sniffing deeply with a happy contented purr.
"You’re back, My Lord!" Eluned squeaked out happily, her silver-green hair spilling over Vespera’s back like living vines.

She pulled her head back slightly with her bright green eyes scanning Vespera’s altered physical form with playful fascinated curiosity. "Mmm... it’s still so strange seeing you in this lightweight female body! Where did your muscular shoulders go? And your left arm is completely gone!"
Vespera chuckled softly, reaching back with her single right hand to gently pat Eluned’s knee.
"It’s just a temporary magic disguise, Eluned," Vespera explained smoothly.

"How did the negotiations go with that rolling fortress man?" Eluned asked eagerly, tilting her head. "Did he try to disrespect you? Do I need to go out there and turn his iron vehicle into a flower pot?"
Vespera let out a short amused laugh, shaking her head.

"No need for flower pots," Vespera replied warmly. "The negotiations went remarkably well, actually. We secured high-tier Central City alloys, luxury spices, and a massive trade deal. However... we did officially agree to engage in an official Lord War one week from today."
Eluned’s eyes lit up with sudden competitive excitement as she puffed out her chest, pointing a delicate finger into the air.
"A Lord War?!" Eluned asked eagerly. "Am I participating, My Lord?! Am I going to be deployed on the frontline?!"
Vespera turned her head, offering the Nature Goddess a soft and incredibly alluring smile that made Eluned’s heart skip three beats.
"Of course you are, Eluned," Vespera answered softly, her voice filled with trust. "You are my strongest asset. What on earth would we ever do without you?"

"Eeeek~!" Eluned let out a high-pitched adorable squeak of pure bliss with her cheeks flushing bright crimson as she squeezed Vespera’s waist even tighter. "I knew it! I’m your favorite... not that pirate."
Vespera smiled, but her expression quickly changed.
"Eluned," Vespera spoke, her voice turning serious. "I need to ask you for a very important favor right now."
Eluned sat up straight on the saddle, her green eyes shining with readiness. "Anything, My Lord! Just name it!"

"Lord Sky’s mobile fortress is equipped with advanced, long-range broadcast drones that stream live footage directly back to Earth," Vespera explained clearly. "Even though they are camped at the outer clearing miles away, I don’t want his camera drones or any high-altitude recon spells catching even a tiny glimpse of what goes on inside our territory over this next week."
Vespera looked into Eluned’s eyes, asking directly.

"Can you construct a high-tier barrier? Something that completely covers the entire Blessed Land in an opaque impenetrable optical and spiritual dome? It needs to block all outside vision and scanning spells, but still allow our own field troops like Morwenna, Brida, and Tasmin to pass through freely when they return from their hunts."
Eluned puffed out her cheeks, offering a confident arrogant smirk that only a primordial deity could pull off.

"Is that all?" Eluned giggled softly, waving her hand dismissively. "My Lord, you are asking a Goddess of Nature to manipulate the environmental spirit mist... Creating a one-way isolation barrier around a mere two-mile radius is child’s play for me!"
Vespera smiled warmly, reaching out with her single hand to gently pat Eluned’s head, stroking her soft silver-green hair.
"Thank you, Eluned," Vespera said softly. "You’re a lifesaver."
"Hehehe~" Eluned giggled happily, leaning into the head-pat like a spoiled kitten.
She had always been like this when Morwenna wasn’t around, if Morwenna saw her acting like this, Eluned didn’t know what she would do.
Eluned swung her delicate legs over the saddle and hopped down off Valkyrie’s back, landing lightly on the courtyard cobblestones.
She turned around to face the vast expanse of the Blessed Land, her gentle playful demeanor instantly hardening into an awe-inspiring divine authority.
FWOOSH!
A dense suffocating wave of pure divine nature mana erupted from Eluned’s slender frame.
Her long, silver-green hair lifted off her shoulders, floating in mid-air as glowing emerald leaves and golden spirit particles materialized around her dress.
An intoxicating mind-soothing aroma of fresh forest lilies, crushed pine needles, and morning dew instantly flooded the entire central area.
Eluned raised both of her pale hands toward the sky. Vespera could not hear most of what she was saying but she sure could hear the last part.
"...Canopy of the World Tree!"
BOOOOOM!
She slammed her right foot against the cobblestones and a massive intricate emerald magic circle spanning over fifty meters in diameter instantly burned itself into the earth beneath her feet.
From the outer perimeter of the giant magic array, thousands of luminous, emerald-green vines and translucent spirit roots erupted violently out of the ground.

The roots shot skyward at blinding speed, soaring hundreds of feet into the air before curving outward in a massive breathtaking arc that completely encompassed the entire territory of the Blessed Land.
RUMBLE... FLASH!
High above their heads, the soaring green roots fused together, weaving a dense impenetrable dome of swirling emerald mist and shimmering floral light.
From the inside looking up, the sky appeared perfectly clear and pleasant, bathed in a gentle warm spirit glare.

But from the outside world looking in... the entire Blessed Land had completely vanished from physical space, replaced by an opaque swirling wall of dense un-scanable green mist that completely repelled all camera drones, optical spyglasses, and spatial radar spells.
Eluned let the divine mana fade from her hands with her hair settling softly over her shoulders.
She turned back toward Vespera, dusting her pale hands off with a satisfied proud grin.
"All done, My Lord!" Eluned proclaimed happily. "The barrier is fully active! Nobody outside can see a single blade of grass inside our walls, but all of our girls can come and go as they please!"
Vespera looked up at the shimmering dome above, impressed by the speed and perfection of the spell.
"Fantastic work, Eluned," Vespera praised warmly.
She reached up with her single right hand, grasping the dark black disguise ring resting on her ring finger, and pulled it off.
FLASH!
A brilliant blinding burst of golden Gold Core light erupted around her frame!
In a fraction of a millisecond, the slender single-armed female vessel of Vespera dissolved completely into fine golden dust.

Standing atop the stone steps was Silas Graves... restored to his full six-foot-two height, his broad, muscular shoulders, his dark hair, his glowing golden-ringed eyes, and both of his calloused powerful arms.
Silas let out a long satisfying breath, stretching his broad arms out wide as his joints cracked loudly in the warm afternoon air.
"Man, it feels good to have my left arm back," Silas muttered in his deep voice, flexing his left fingers.
He looked down at Eluned, offering her a genuine affectionate smile. "Thank you, Elu. Seriously."
The second Silas transformed back into his true male form, Eluned’s green eyes turned completely round and sparkly.
She didn’t hesitate for a single microsecond as she launched her slender body straight through the air like an eager puppy leaping into her owner’s arms.
"MY LORD!" Eluned squeaked out happily.
PLOP!
Silas instinctively caught her out of mid-air, wrapping his broad, muscular right arm around her slender waist and lifting her effortlessly off her feet.
Eluned immediately wrapped her arms tightly around his neck, looking down at his sharp face with hungry affectionate eyes, pouting her soft lips dramatically.
"Hold me close, My Lord!" Eluned demanded cutely, wriggling against his broad chest. "I used a big divine spell for you! You have to reward me properly right now!"
Silas chuckled warmly, shaking his head at her shameless demand.
But seeing how hard she had worked today to protect the Keep, he had zero intention of denying her.
Silas tightened his grip around her waist, pulling her flush against his chest, and leaned his head up to capture her soft lips in a deep passionate kiss.
"Mmmph~!" Eluned let out a soft surprised gasp into his mouth with her green eyes fluttering shut as pure dizzying ecstasy exploded through her veins.
She immediately wrapped her legs around his waist, reciprocating the kiss with fiery breathless passion, burying her fingers deep into his dark hair.
Inside her mind, the Nature Goddess was practically floating in a cloud of pink hearts.
’Ahhhhh~! I love being rewarded so much! His lips are so warm and masculine! Mmmm~!’

After a long, breathless moment that left Eluned completely panting and red-faced in his arms, Silas gently broke the kiss, resting his forehead against hers as both of their breaths mingled in the cool air.
Silas let out a soft quiet sigh, looking into her glowing green eyes.

"I know it’s annoying having me switch back and forth," Silas explained softly. "But that Lord Sky outside is streaming live to tens of millions of people back on Earth. I need to keep my real identity as Silas Graves completely hidden from the government and the World Council for as long as possible... that’s the only reason I’m wearing Thora’s disguise ring when I step outside."
Eluned looked into his golden-ringed eyes, a serene breathtakingly sweet, and utterly devoted smile spreading across her divine face.
She reached up, gently cupping his cheek with her soft hand.

"You don’t ever have to apologize to me, My Lord," Eluned whispered lovingly, her voice dripping with unshakeable devotion. "Whether you appear as a tall handsome man, or a beautiful one-armed black-haired woman... my soul belongs to you entirely. I will gladly accept your kisses regardless of what body you wear."
